title: Fire at nursing home in Chile kills 16 residents
english: A tragic fire at the El Edén nursing home in southern Chile resulted in the deaths of 16 elderly residents. While ten people were safely evacuated, the cause of the late-night blaze remains under investigation. In response to the disaster, the Chilean president has ordered a nationwide review of safety standards at nursing facilities to prevent similar future tragedies.
amharic: በደቡባዊ ቺሊ በሚገኝ ኤል ኤደን በተባለ የጡረተኞች መጦሪያ ጣቢያ በተነሳ የእሳት አደጋ 16 አረጋውያን ህይወታቸው አልፏል። አስር ሰዎች በህይወት ቢተርፉም፣ የእሳቱ መንስኤ እስካሁን አልታወቀም። የቺሊ ፕሬዝዳንት ተመሳሳይ አሳዛኝ ሁኔታ እንዳይደገም በመላ ሀገሪቱ የሚገኙ የመጦሪያ ጣቢያዎችን የደህንነት ሁኔታ በድጋሚ እንዲመረመር ትዕዛዝ ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Masaraa ga’eessota ykn maanguddoota 'El Edén' jedhamu kan kibba biyya Chilee keessatti argamu irratti ibiddii tasa ka'een maanguddoonni 16 lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Namoonni kudhan balaa kana jalaa kan ba’an yoo ta’u, sababni ibiddichaa hanga ammaatti ifa hin taane. Prezidaantiin biyyattii balaa kana booda, gadda guddaa ibsuun, namoonni kan biroo akka hin miidhamneef fooyya’iinsa nageenyaa manneen maanguddootaa hunda irratti akka godhamu ajajanii jiru.

title: Israel bombs southern Lebanon as talks postponed
english: Negotiations between Israel and Lebanon, facilitated by the United States, have been delayed until October. These discussions, originally planned for this month in Rome, are currently on hold. Meanwhile, the conflict continues as Israeli forces maintain military strikes across southern Lebanon.
amharic: በአሜሪካ አደራዳሪነት በእስራኤል እና በሊባኖስ መካከል ይካሄድ የነበረው የድርድር ሂደት እስከ ጥቅምት ወር ድረስ ተራዝሟል። በሮም ይካሄዳል ተብሎ ይጠበቅ የነበረው ይህ ውይይት ለጊዜው ታግዷል። ይህ በእንዲህ እንዳለ፣ የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ ላይ ጥቃታቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Mariin gidduu galeessa Ameerikaan Israa'elii fi Libanoos gidduutti gaggeeffamaa ture gara ji'a Onkololeessaatti dabarfameera. Mariin kun kanaan dura ji'a kana magaalaa Roomaatti akka gaggeeffamu karoorfamee ture. Yeroo ammaa kanatti Israa'el kibba Libanoosirratti weerara ishee kan itti fuftee jirtu yommuu ta'u, mariin kunis yeroof addaan citeera.

title: Gaza genocide documentary ‘NAZA’ wins Special Jury Prize at Venice
english: The documentary film 'NAZA', which focuses on the mass killing of Palestinians in Gaza, has been awarded the Special Jury Prize at the Venice Film Festival. During the event, co-director Yuval Abraham stated that the violence was intentional rather than accidental, citing accounts from Israeli intelligence sources. He also criticized Western nations for their role in supporting these actions.
amharic: በጋዛ ስለተፈጸመው የፍልስጤማውያን ጭፍጨፋ የሚያትተው 'ናዛ' የተሰኘው ዘጋቢ ፊልም በቬኒስ የፊልም ፌስቲቫል የልዩ ዳኞች ሽልማትን አሸንፏል። የፊልሙ ተባባሪ ዳይሬክተር ዩቫል አብርሃም እንደገለጹት፣ በጋዛ የተፈጸመው ድርጊት በአጋጣሚ ሳይሆን ታቅዶ የተፈጸመ መሆኑን ከእስራኤል የደህንነት መኮንኖች እንደሰሙ ተናግረዋል። በተጨማሪም ምዕራባውያን አገራት ለዚህ ጥቃት ድጋፍ በመስጠት ተባባሪ መሆናቸውን በመግለጽ ወቀሳቸውን አሰምተዋል።
oromo: Fiilmiin 'NAZA' jedhamu kan waa'ee dhumaatii Falasxiinotaa Gaazaa keessatti raawwatamee ibsu, ayyaana fiilmii Veeniis irratti badhaasa addaa fudhateera. Qindeessaan fiilmichaa Yuval Abrahaam akka ibsetti, ajjeechaan kun tasa kan uumame osoo hin taane karoorfamee kan raawwatame ta'uu fiila'oolee odeeffannoo Israa'el irraa dhageenyee jedheera. Kana malees, biyyoonni lixaa gocha kana deeggaruudhaan itti gaafatamummaa qabu jechuun komateera.

title: US court blocks Trump administration plan to cut disaster agency workforce
english: A US federal judge has blocked the Trump administration's attempt to reduce the workforce at FEMA, the agency responsible for responding to national disasters. The judge ruled that the Department of Homeland Security exceeded its legal authority by trying to significantly cut the number of emergency reservists without providing a valid justification. This decision protects the agency's operational independence, which is legally mandated to ensure effective disaster response across the country.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የፌዴራል ዳኛ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር የተፈጥሮ አደጋዎችን የሚቆጣጠረውን የፌማ (FEMA) ተቋም የሰው ኃይል ለመቀነስ ያቀደውን ዕቅድ አግደዋል። ዳኛዋ የሀገር ውስጥ ደህንነት መሥሪያ ቤት ተገቢውን ምክንያት ሳያቀርብ የአደጋ ጊዜ ሠራተኞችን ቁጥር በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ለመቀነስ መሞከሩ ከሕግ ውጭ ነው ብለዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ ተቋሙ አገራዊ አደጋዎችን ለመከላከል ያለውን ነጻነትና አቅም ለማስጠበቅ ያለመ ነው።
oromo: Abbaan seeraa federaalaa kan Ameerikaa, mootummaan Trump dhaabbata balaa uumamaa FEMA jedhamu irratti hojjettoota hirisuuf baasee ture akka dhaabatu murteesseera. Abbaan seerichaa, Ministeerri Nageenya Biyoolessaa sababa gahaa malee hojjettoota ariifachiisaa hirisuun aangoo isaa akka darbe ibseera. Murteen kun dhaabbatichi balaa uumamaa ittisuuf gahee isaa akka bahuuf bilisummaa isaa eeguuf gargaara.

title: Bahrain says it will not participate in Iran’s proposed Hormuz meeting
english: Bahrain has officially declined an invitation to join a regional meeting in Oman regarding the future of the Strait of Hormuz, which is currently blockaded by Iran. The Bahraini government stated that it will not engage in such discussions with Tehran until formal diplomatic relations are restored between the two nations. Furthermore, Bahrain criticized Iran's approach, arguing that regional security cannot be achieved through policies of appeasement while the waterway remains restricted.
amharic: ባህሬን በኢራን ቁጥጥር ስር ባለው የሆርሙዝ ስትሬት የወደፊት ሁኔታ ላይ ለመወያየት በኦማን እንዲካሄድ የታቀደውን ስብሰባ እንደማትሳተፍ አስታውቃለች። የባህሬን መንግስት ከኢራን ጋር ዲፕሎማሲያዊ ግንኙነት እስካልተመለሰ ድረስ ከሀገሪቱ ጋር በማንኛውም የጋራ ስብሰባ ላይ እንደማትገኝ ገልጿል። በተጨማሪም ሀገሪቱ የክልሉን ደህንነት ለማረጋገጥ መተማመኛን ሳይሆን የባህር መስመሩ ያለ ምንም ቅድመ ሁኔታ ለሁሉም ክፍት መሆን እንዳለበት አሳስባለች።
oromo: Bahrain walgahii biyyoota naannichaa kan Omaanitti qophaa'e fi gara fuulduraa daandii galaana Hormuz irratti mari'achuuf karoorfame irratti akka hirmaattu affeeramtes diddeetti. Mootummaan Bahraini akka ibsetti, hariiroon dippilomaasii biyyoota lamaan gidduutti haaraa erga hin deebi'in, marii Iran waliin ta'u irratti hirmaachuuf fedhii hin qabu. Gama biraatiin, Bahrain nageenyi naannichaa kan mirkanaa'u siyaasa jaalalaan osoo hin taane, daandiin galaana sun dhiibbaa fi kaffaltii tokko malee bilisa ta'uu qaba jettee amanti.

title: Will Houthi advances in Yemen give Iran leverage in its war with the US?
english: The Houthi movement has expanded its control over Yemen’s Red Sea coastline, specifically near the vital Bab al-Mandeb strait. This strategic advancement threatens global oil supplies and places new pressure on Saudi Arabia, raising concerns about a potential escalation in the conflict between the United States and Iran. Analysts are now questioning whether this development provides Tehran with increased influence and a stronger position in its ongoing regional tensions with Washington.
amharic: የሁቲ አማጽያን በየመን ቀይ ባህር ጠረፍ አካባቢ እና በባብ አል-ማንደብ የባህር መስመር ላይ ቁጥጥራቸውን በማጠናከራቸው ስጋት ፈጥረዋል። ይህ ስልታዊ እንቅስቃሴ ለነዳጅ አቅርቦት ስጋት በመፍጠር በሳውዲ አረቢያ ላይ ከፍተኛ ጫና እያሳደረ ሲሆን፣ በአሜሪካ እና በኢራን መካከል ያለውን ግጭት የበለጠ ሊያባብሰው ይችላል ተብሎ ተሰግቷል። በዚህም ምክንያት፣ ይህ ድርጊት ለኢራን በአሜሪካ ላይ ያላትን የድርድር አቅም እና ተጽዕኖ ከፍ ሊያደርግ ይችላል ወይ የሚለው ጥያቄ ተነስቷል።
oromo: Humni Houtii qarqara galaana diimaa Yaman to’achuu isaa fi bakka tarsiimawaa kan ta’e Bab al-Mandeb irratti injifannoo argachuun isaa sodaa guddaa uumeera. Tarkaanfiin kun dhiyeessii boba’aa addunyaa irratti dhiibbaa kan uumuufi biyya Sa’udii Arabiyaa rakkoo keessa kan galche ta’us, walitti bu’iinsa Ameerikaa fi Iraan gidduu jiru daran hammaachisuu danda’a. Kanaan walqabatee, guddinni kun Iraan humna Ameerikaa wajjin jiru irratti dhiibbaa caalu akka gootuufi bakka injifannoo irra akka geessu ishee gargaaruu danda’a jechuun qorattoonni gaaffii keessa galchaa jiru.

title: Yemen government forces say hit Houthis in Red Sea city
english: Yemeni government forces recently launched military strikes against Houthi fighters in the port city of Mocha. This conflict has intensified as the Houthis successfully seized control of the remaining Red Sea coastline and critical islands in the area. Consequently, these military operations have triggered a significant increase in the number of civilians being displaced from their homes.
amharic: የየመን የመንግስት ኃይሎች በሞቻ ወደብ ከተማ በሚገኙ የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። የሁቲ ቡድን የቀረውን የየመን ቀይ ባህር ጠረፍ እና ስልታዊ ደሴቶችን በመቆጣጠሩ ግጭቱ ተባብሷል። በዚህ ውጊያ ምክንያት ከየቤታቸው የሚፈናቀሉ ሲቪሎች ቁጥርም በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ ጨምሯል።
oromo: Humnoonni mootummaa Yaman magaalaa buufata doonii Mochaa keessatti loltoota Huutii irratti haleellaa raawwachuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Gareen Huutii qarqara galaana diimaa Yaman keessatti hafe fi bakkoota tarsiimawaa ta'an to'annaa isaanii jala waan galchaniif waraanni kun daran hammaateera. Walitti bu'iinsa kanaan walqabatee namoonni nagaa qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'anii godaanan baay'inaan dabaleera.

title: Trump says Houthis asked US not to intervene in Yemen
english: President Donald Trump claims the Houthi group in Yemen contacted the U.S. to request that Washington avoid interfering in their conflict with Saudi Arabia. Despite Saudi pressure to launch military strikes following Houthi advances near critical shipping lanes, Trump has so far refused to intervene. Meanwhile, the region remains tense as drone attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure continue to threaten energy supplies.
amharic: የአሜሪካው ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ፣ የየመኑ ሁቲ አማፂያን ከአሜሪካ ጋር እንዳይጋጩና አሜሪካ በየመን ግጭት ውስጥ ጣልቃ እንዳትገባ ጥያቄ ማቅረባቸውን ተናግረዋል። የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በቀይ ባህር የንግድ መስመሮች ላይ ቁጥጥር እያደረጉ ቢሆንም፣ ትራምፕ ሳውዲ አረቢያ ያቀረበችውን ወታደራዊ እርምጃ የመውሰድ ጥያቄ ውድቅ አድርገዋል። በሌላ በኩል፣ በሳውዲ የነዳጅ ማስተላለፊያ መስመሮች ላይ የሚሰነዘሩ የድሮን ጥቃቶች በክልሉ ያለውን ውጥረት እና የነዳጅ ዋጋ ስጋት ከፍ አድርገውታል።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp akka jedhanitti, gareen Huutii kan Yaman keessa jiru tokkummaan isaanii fi biyyi Sa'udii akka walitti hin bu'ineef Ameerikaan gidduu akka hin galle gaafateera. Huutiin daandiiwwan markabaa irratti to'annoo babal'ifachaa jiraatus, Tiraamp mootummaan Sa'udii lola akka irratti banuuf dhiheesseef diddeera. Yeroo ammaa kanatti, miidhaan bu'uuraalee misoomaa boba'aa Sa'udii irratti raawwatamaa jiru naannichatti yaaddoo nageenyaa fi gatii boba'aa dabalee jira.

title: Saudi civil defence says two wounded by Houthi projectile
english: Two people were injured after a projectile fired by Houthi rebels struck a border region in southern Saudi Arabia. The attack caused property damage to local vehicles, buildings, and a mosque. Saudi authorities had issued warnings about potential strikes shortly before the incident occurred.
amharic: በሳውዲ አረቢያ ደቡባዊ ድንበር ላይ በሁቲ አማጽያን በተተኮሰ ሚሳይል ሁለት ሰዎች ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። ጥቃቱ በአካባቢው በሚገኙ መኪኖች፣ ህንጻዎች እና መስጊድ ላይ የቁሳቁስ ውድመት አስከትሏል። የሳውዲ ባለስልጣናት ጥቃቱ ከመፈጸሙ ጥቂት ሰዓታት ቀደም ብሎ ሊከሰቱ ስለሚችሉ አደጋዎች ማስጠንቀቂያ ሰጥተው ነበር።
oromo: Houthi warra finxaaleyyii ta'aniin meeshaan waraanaa gara daangaa kibba Saudii Arabiyaatti dhukaafame namoota lama irratti miidhaa geessiseera. Miidhaan kun konkolaattota, mana amantaa fi gamoo garaa garaa irratti miidhaa qabeenyaa dhaqqabsiiseera. Aangeyyoonni Saudii miidhaan kun osoo hin raawwatamin sa'aatii muraasa dura akeekkachiisa kennanii turan.

title: Explosions heard off coast of Qeshm in southern Iran, report says
english: State media in Iran reported that two loud explosions were heard near Qeshm Island in the Strait of Hormuz on Saturday. This incident occurs amid heightened tensions in the region, characterized by an ongoing series of retaliatory strikes between Iranian forces and the United States. These military hostilities have frequently impacted oil tankers and strategic maritime routes in the Gulf.
amharic: የኢራን የመንግስት ሚዲያ በቅሽም ደሴት አቅራቢያ በሆርሙዝ የባህር ወሽመጥ አካባቢ ሁለት ኃይለኛ ፍንዳታዎች እንደተሰሙ ዘግቧል። ይህ ክስተት በኢራን እና በአሜሪካ መካከል ያለው የውጥረት ሁኔታ እየተባባሰ በሄደበት ወቅት የተፈጠረ ነው። በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ያለው ግጭት የነዳጅ ማመላለሻ መርከቦችን እና በክልሉ የሚገኙ ስትራቴጂካዊ የባህር መስመሮችን ለከፍተኛ ስጋት ዳርጓል።
oromo: Miidiyaan mootummaa Iraan akka gabaasetti, guyyaa Sanbataa naannoo jireenyaa Qeshm kan gubbaa galaana Hormuzitti dhukaatiin guddaan lama dhaga'ameera. Taateen kun kan uumame yeroo waraanni fi wal-dhabiinsi gidduu Iraanii fi Ameerikaa jidduu jiru daran hammaachaa jiru keessaatti. Wal-dhabiinsi kun dooniiwwan boba'aa fe'an fi daandiiwwan galaanaatti fayyadamtoota ta'an irratti miidhaa geessisaa jira.

title: Selling the war: Purges, polygraphs and propaganda
english: The Trump administration is struggling to maintain a positive narrative regarding the ongoing conflict with Iran as the US midterm elections approach. Factors such as rising living costs, aggressive social media communications, and strained relations between the Pentagon and the press have made it difficult to sway public opinion. These challenges highlight the administration's increasing difficulty in managing its wartime messaging effectively.
amharic: የአሜሪካ መካከለኛ ዘመን ምርጫ እየቀረበ ባለበት ወቅት የትራምፕ አስተዳደር ከኢራን ጋር ስላለው ግጭት አዎንታዊ ገጽታ ለመፍጠር እየተቸገረ ነው። የኑሮ ውድነት መጨመር፣ የፕሬዚዳንቱ ቀስቃሽ የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ መልእክቶች እና በመከላከያ ሚኒስቴር እና በጋዜጠኞች መካከል ያለው ውጥረት መንግሥት ለህዝብ የሚሰጠውን መልእክት ተቀባይነት እንዳያገኝ አድርገውታል። እነዚህ ተግዳሮቶች አስተዳደሩ በጦርነት ጊዜ የሚከተለውን የፕሮፓጋንዳ ስራ ለማስተዳደር ምን ያህል እየተቸገረ እንዳለ ያሳያሉ።
oromo: Filannoon giddu-galeessa Ameerikaa dhiyaachaa waan jiruuf, bulchiinsi Trump walitti bu'iinsa Iran waliin jiru irratti miira gaarii uumuuf rakkachaa jira. Gatiin boba'aa fi nyaataa dabaluun, ergaawwan miidiyaalee hawaasaa irratti maxxanfaman kanneen mufachiisoo ta'anii fi hariiroon Pentagoonii fi miidiyaalee gidduu jiru hojiin mootummaan ergaa isaa uummata biraan gahuuf yaalu akka hin milkoofne taasiseera. Rakkoon kun bulchiinsi Trump yeroo waraanaatti mala odeeffannoo isaa to'achuuf dhiibbaa cimaa keessa akka jiru agarsiisa.

title: India vs Sri Lanka: Women’s T20 Asia Cup 2026 final – schedule, teams, form
english: India and Sri Lanka are set to compete in the Women’s T20 Asia Cup final this Sunday at the Dubai International Stadium. India enters the match looking for their eighth tournament title, while the defending champions, Sri Lanka, hope to repeat their victory from two years ago. Both teams have performed strongly throughout the event and are prepared for this highly anticipated championship decider.
amharic: የህንድ እና የሲሪላንካ የሴቶች የቲ-20 የእስያ ዋንጫ የፍጻሜ ጨዋታ እሁድ በዱባይ ዓለም አቀፍ ስታዲየም ይካሄዳል። ህንድ ስምንተኛውን የውድድሩን ዋንጫ ለማንሳት ስትዘጋጅ፣ ባለፈው ውድድር አሸናፊ የነበሩት ሲሪላንካዎች ደግሞ ድላቸውን ለመድገም ይሞክራሉ። ሁለቱም ቡድኖች በውድድሩ ጥሩ ብቃት በማሳየት ለፍጻሜው ጨዋታ ዝግጅታቸውን አጠናቀዋል።
oromo: Taphi xumuraa waancaa T20 Eshiyaa kan dubartoota gidduu Itiyoophiyaa fi Siiriilaankaa gidduutti Dilbata dhufu kan gaggeeffamu ta'a. Indiyaan waancaa kana yeroo saddeettaffaaf injifachuuf kan karfeessitu yoo ta'u, Siiriilaankaan immoo qophee darbe injifatte san deebitee mirkaneeffachuuf carraaqqii gooti. Gareewwan lamaanuu yeroo hunda taphichatti gaarii waan turaniif, taphichi guddinaan kan eeggamu ta'a.

title: Man arrested over killing of Tasia Fortune, found hanging from tree
english: Authorities in Mississippi have taken Jarques Ratliff into custody regarding the death of Tasia Fortune. The victim, a Black woman, was discovered hanging from a tree last month. Although initially unclear, officials eventually classified her death as a homicide, prompting calls from lawmakers for a federal investigation into the incident.
amharic: በሚሲሲፒ ግዛት ፖሊስ ታሲያ ፎርቹን የተባለችውን ሴት በመግደል ወንጀል ጃርክስ ራትሊፍ የተባለ ግለሰብን በቁጥጥር ስር አውሏል። የሟች አስከሬን ባለፈው ወር በዛፍ ላይ ተንጠልጥሎ የተገኘ ሲሆን፣ ምርመራው ግድያ መሆኑን ካረጋገጠ በኋላ ጉዳዩ በፌዴራል ደረጃ እንዲጣራ የህግ አውጪዎች ጥያቄ አቅርበዋል።
oromo: Poolisiin naannoo Mississippi namicha Jarques Ratliff jedhamu, ajjeechaa dubartii Tasia Fortune jedhamtuun walqabatee qabuu isaa beeksiseera. Reeffi dubartittii ji'a darbe muka irratti fannifamee kan argame yoo ta'u, qorannoon booda ajjeechaa ta'uun isaa mirkanaa'eera. Kanaan walqabatee, qaamoleen seera baastuun dhimmi kun gadi fageenyaan akka qoratamu gaafachaa jiru.

title: Couple welcomes child from embryo frozen for 22 years
english: A Greek couple recently celebrated the birth of a baby from an embryo that had been frozen for 22 years. The successful IVF procedure occurred in Athens as the mother neared the government-mandated age limit of 54 for such treatments. This event marks a significant medical achievement regarding the long-term preservation of embryos.
amharic: አንድ የግሪክ ባልና ሚስት ለ22 ዓመታት በበረዶ ተከማችቶ የቆየ ፅንስ በመጠቀም ልጅ መውለዳቸውን አብስረዋል። አቴንስ ውስጥ የተወለደው ህጻን፣ እናትየው በሕግ ከተቀመጠው የ54 ዓመት የዕድሜ ጣሪያ ላይ ከመድረሷ በፊት በተደረገ የፅንስ ማስተላለፍ ሂደት የተገኘ ነው። ይህ ክስተት የፅንስ ረጅም ጊዜ የመቆየት አቅምን የሚያሳይ አስደናቂ የሕክምና ውጤት ሆኗል።
oromo: Hiriyoonni gaa'elaa gariig tokko, embriyoon waggoota 22f cabbii keessatti kuufamee ture fayyadamuudhaan mucaa godhataniiru. Mucichi magaalaa Atenasitti kan dhalate yoo ta'u, kunis haati sun umrii seeraan IVFf hayyamame kan waggaa 54 gahuuf yeroo gabaabaa hafee jirutti kan raawwatameedha. Taateen kun carraaqqii saayinsii fayyaa keessatti embriyoowwan yeroo dheeraaf qulqullina isaanii eeggachuu danda'an ilaalchisee milkaa'ina guddaa agarsiisa.

title: US Open women’s singles final live: Aryna Sabalenka vs Elena Rybakina
english: Aryna Sabalenka is set to face Elena Rybakina in the highly anticipated US Open women’s singles final. The championship match is scheduled to take place at Arthur Ashe Stadium in New York. Fans can follow live updates, statistical analysis, and expert commentary as Sabalenka attempts to defend her title.
amharic: አሪና ሳባሌንካ በዩኤስ ኦፕን የሴቶች የነጠላ ፍጻሜ ጨዋታ ከኤሌና ሪባኪና ጋር ይፋለማሉ። የሻምፒዮናው ጨዋታ በኒው ዮርክ በሚገኘው አርተር አሽ ስታዲየም የሚካሄድ ይሆናል። አድናቂዎች ሳባሌንካ ዋንጫዋን ለመከላከል በምታደርገው ጥረት የቀጥታ መረጃዎችን፣ የስታቲስቲክስ ትንታኔዎችን እና የባለሙያዎችን አስተያየት መከታተል ይችላሉ።
oromo: Aryna Sabalenka fi Elena Rybakina tapha xumuraa korguu dubartoota US Open irratti wal morkachuuf qophaa’aniiru. Taphi injifannoo kun magaala New Yorkitti bakka Arthur Ashe Stadium jedhamutti kan gaggeeffamu ta'a. Sabalenka mata duree ishee itti fufuuf qophii ishee taasiftuun walqabatee, hordoftoonni odeeffannoo yeroo gabaabaa, xiinxala stats fi yaada ogeessotaa hordofuu danda’u.

title: Israel uses Lebanese civilians as bargaining chips
english: Israeli military forces recently entered the southern Lebanese village of Halta and detained three local residents from their homes. Among those taken was a municipal council member named Hatem Abdel-Aal, who was eventually released late that night under strict orders to report back on foot. Witnesses suggest these actions indicate that Israeli troops are using local civilians as leverage during the ongoing border conflict.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይሎች በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኘው የሃልታ መንደር በመግባት ሶስት ነዋሪዎችን ከቤታቸው አፍነው ወስደዋል። ከተያዙት መካከል የከተማው ምክር ቤት አባል የሆኑት ሀተም አብደል-አል ይገኙበታል፤ እነርሱም በለሊት ቢለቀቁም እንደገና በእግር እንዲመጡ ትእዛዝ ተሰጥቷቸዋል። የአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች እንደገለጹት፣ እስራኤል እነዚህን ሲቪሎች በድንበር ግጭቱ ወቅት እንደ መደራደሪያ እየተጠቀመችባቸው ነው።
oromo: Humnoonni waraana Israa'el ganda Halta jedhamtu kan kibba Libaanoositti argamtu seenuun jiraattota sadii manneen isaanii keessaa qabanii fudhataniiru. Namoota qabaman kana keessaa miseensi mana maree magaalaa Hatem Abdel-Aal kan argamu yoo ta'u, halkan keessa gadi lakkifamus miilaan akka deebi'anii gabaasaniif ajajamaniiru. Ragaan akka mul'isutti, gochi kun Israa'el lolli daangaa irratti geggeeffamaa jiruuf jireenya lammiilee kana akka meeshaa dhimma itti baatuu fi mallattoo dhiibbaa itti gochuutti fayyadamaa akka jirtu agarsiisa.

title: Houthis say liberated more than 200 prisoners in newly captured regions
english: The Houthi group in Yemen announced the release of over 200 of their fighters who were held captive by Saudi-backed forces. These individuals were freed after the Houthis launched a significant military offensive to seize new territories near the Bab al-Mandab Strait. Some of these released prisoners had been in detention for as long as eight years.
amharic: የየመኑ የሁቲ ቡድን በሳዑዲ በሚደገፉ ኃይሎች ታስረው የነበሩ ከ200 በላይ ታጣቂዎቹን መፍታታቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ታጣቂዎቹ ነፃ የወጡት የሁቲ ቡድን በባብ አል-ማንዳብ ስትሬት አቅራቢያ በሚገኙ አካባቢዎች ባደረገው ፈጣን ወታደራዊ ጥቃት ነው። ከተለቀቁት መካከል አንዳንዶቹ እስከ ስምንት ዓመት ድረስ በእስር ላይ እንደነበሩ ተገልጿል።
oromo: gareen Huutii Yaman keessatti argamu, loltoota isaa 200 ol ta'an kanneen humnoota Sa'udii deggarramaniin qabamanii turan gadhifamuu isaanii beeksiseera. Loltoonni kun kan gadhifaman gareen kun naannoo Bab al-Mandab jedhamutti tarkaanfii waraanaa fudhateen lafa haarawa to'annoo isaa jala oolchuu isaatiin booda. Loltoota gadhifaman kana keessaa muraasni isaanii hanga waggaa saddeetiif hidhaa keessa turaniiru.

title: Iran-Oman understanding does not provide for immediate reopening of Strait of Hormuz, Tasnim reports
english: A recent agreement between Iran and Oman sets a foundation for the potential reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, though it will not happen right away. Iranian officials indicated that this move aims to solidify their control over the waterway. Ultimately, any decision to open the strait remains contingent upon the United States agreeing to specific terms set by Tehran.
amharic: በኢራን እና በኦማን መካከል የተደረሰው ስምምነት የሆርሙዝ የባህር በርን ወዲያውኑ ለመክፈት የሚያስችል አይደለም፤ ነገር ግን ለወደፊት ለመክፈት መሰረት ይጥላል። የኢራን ምንጮች እንደገለጹት ይህ እርምጃ ሀገሪቱ በባህር ሰላጤው ላይ ያላትን ሉዓላዊነት ለማረጋገጥ ያለመ ነው። የባህር በሩ ሙሉ በሙሉ የሚከፈተው አሜሪካ የኢራንን ቅድመ ሁኔታዎች ስትቀበል ብቻ እንደሆነ ተገልጿል።
oromo: waliigalteen Iran fi Oman gidduutti godhame karaa Hormuz battalaan banuuf kan hin gargaarre ta'us, gara fuulduraatti banamuuf bu'ura kan ta'u dha. Maddoonni Iran akka ibsanitti, tarkiinni kun irratti aangoo guutuu qabaachuu isaanii mirkaneeffachuuf kan karoorfame dha. Haata'u malee, karichi akka banamuuf haala murteessaa ta'e irratti, kutaan kun kan hundaa'u Ameerikaan gaaffilee Iran fudhattee yoo raawwatte qofa dha.

title: UK expresses ‘solidarity’ with Saudi Arabia over Houthi attacks
english: The British government recently voiced its support for Saudi Arabia following ongoing Houthi attacks from Yemen. During a discussion between top officials, Britain acknowledged Saudi Arabia's right to protect its borders and resources in accordance with international rules. Both nations also committed to working together to safeguard maritime trade routes and ensure global supply chains remain secure.
amharic: የብሪታንያ መንግስት በየመን ሁቲዎች ለሚፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች ሳውዲ አረቢያን እንደሚደግፍ ገልጿል። በሁለቱ ሀገራት ከፍተኛ ዲፕሎማቶች መካከል በተደረገ ውይይት፣ ብሪታንያ ሳውዲ አረቢያ በአለም አቀፍ ህግ መሰረት ራሷን የመከላከል መብት እንዳላት አረጋግጣለች። በተጨማሪም ሀገራቱ የባህር ላይ ንግድን ለመጠበቅ እና ዓለም አቀፍ የዕቃ አቅርቦት ሰንሰለት እንዳይስተጓጎል በጋራ ለመስራት ተስማምተዋል።
oromo: Mootummaan Biritish ergaa deggersaa Saudii Arabiyaaf ergeera, kunis haleellaa garee Huutii kan Yemen irraa geggeeffamu hordofuudhaani. Marii ministirootaa gaggeeffameen, Biritish Saudiin seera addunyaatiin of ittisuuf mirga qabaachuu ishee beekamtii kenniteetti. Akkasumas, lameen isaanii karaa bishaan irraa akka eegamuufi dhiyeessiin meeshaalee addunyaa walirraa hin cinneef waliin hojjechuuf walii galaniiru.

title: At least 76,000 have fled fighting in Yemen since July, UN says
english: The United Nations reports that at least 76,000 people have been forced to leave their homes in Yemen since July due to ongoing conflict. This displacement figure has quadrupled in just the last week as clashes between government troops and Houthi rebels have intensified. International agencies are expressing urgent concern over the rapidly deteriorating humanitarian situation in the region.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ድርጅት እንደገለጸው ከሐምሌ ወር ጀምሮ በየመን እየተካሄደ ባለው ግጭት ሳቢያ ቢያንስ 76,000 ሰዎች ከመኖሪያቸው ተፈናቅለዋል። በመንግስት ኃይሎች እና በሁቲ አማፂያን መካከል ያለው ግጭት ተባብሶ በመቀጠሉ፣ የተፈናቃዮች ቁጥር ባለፈው ሳምንት ብቻ በአራት እጥፍ ጨምሯል። ዓለም አቀፍ ተቋማት በየመን እየተባባሰ የመጣውን የሰብአዊ ቀውስ አስመልክቶ ከፍተኛ ስጋታቸውን ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni Mootummoota Gamtoomanii akka ibsetti, ji'a Adooleessaa irraa eegalee lola Yemen keessatti gaggeeffamaa jiruun namoonni gara 76,000 ta'an qe'ee isaanii irraa buqqa'aniiru. Waraanni humnoota mootummaa fi warra Houthi gidduutti cimuun isaa, lakkoofsi namoota buqqa'anii torbee darbe qofa keessatti akka dachaa afuriin dabalu godheera. Dhaabbileen idil-addunyaa rakkoo namoomaa Yemen keessatti hammaataa jiru kanaaf yaaddoo cimaa qabu.

title: Anthropic boss Dario Amodei calls for AI development to slow down
english: Dario Amodei, the CEO of the AI company Anthropic, has urged the technology industry to slow down the rapid development of artificial intelligence. He argues that while AI offers many benefits, the serious risks it poses require stricter independent monitoring and global regulation. His proposal aims to ensure safety is prioritized before machines become too powerful or difficult to control.
amharic: የአንትሮፒክ ኩባንያ ዋና ስራ አስፈፃሚ ዳሪዮ አሞዴይ፣ የሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) የቴክኖሎጂ እድገት በከፍተኛ ፍጥነት እየገሰገሰ በመሆኑ እንዲቀንስ ጥሪ አቅርበዋል። ምንም እንኳን ቴክኖሎጂው ብዙ ጥቅሞች ቢኖሩትም፣ ሊያስከትል የሚችለው አደገኛ ሁኔታዎች ስላሉ ጥብቅ ቁጥጥር እና አለም አቀፍ ደንቦችን ማውጣት እንደሚያስፈልግ ገልጸዋል። አላማውም ቴክኖሎጂው ከቁጥጥር ውጪ ከመሆኑ በፊት የደህንነት ጉዳዮችን ቅድሚያ እንዲሰጥ ነው።
oromo: Hogganaan dhaabbata Anthropic, Dario Amodei, saffisni guddina teknooloojii 'Artificial Intelligence' (AI) akka hir'atu gaafateera. AI faayidaa hedduu qabaatus, balaa inni fiduu danda'u ittisuuf hordoffii cimaa fi seera addunyaalessaa barbaachisaa ta'uu ibseera. Kaayyoon isaa teknooloojiin kun hamma isaa darbee to'annoo ala ta'uun isaa dura, dhimmi nageenyaa xiyyeeffannoo argachuu akka qabu dha.

title: French officials investigate if malicious act caused train derailment
english: French authorities are investigating a train derailment in Normandy that injured 44 people, including one person who was critically hurt. Investigators suspect the crash may have been caused by a piece of metal intentionally placed on the tracks. Officials have recovered the train's data recorder and are conducting interviews to determine if the incident was a deliberate act of sabotage.
amharic: በፈረንሳይ ሰሜናዊ ክፍል የተከሰተውን የባቡር መገፍትር አደጋ የፈረንሳይ ባለስልጣናት ምርመራ እያደረጉበት ነው። በአደጋው 44 ሰዎች የቆሰሉ ሲሆን፣ አንዲት ወጣት በከባድ ሁኔታ ሆስፒታል ገብታ ነበር። ተመራማሪዎች በባቡር ሀዲድ ላይ ሆን ተብሎ የተቀመጠ የብረት ቁራጭ ለአደጋው ምክንያት ሊሆን እንደሚችል በመጠርጠር፣ ድርጊቱ ሆን ተብሎ የተፈፀመ የጥፋት ተግባር መሆኑን ለማረጋገጥ ምርመራቸውን ቀጥለዋል።
oromo: Hojjettooni mootummaa Faransaay balaa baaburaa kaaba biyyattitti mudate irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiru. Balaa kanaan namoonni 44 miidhaniiru, isaan keessaas dubartittiin tokko miidhaan cimaan irra gahee ture. Qorattoonni balaan kun kan uumame gartuu sibiilaa karaa baaburaa irratti hirameera ta'uu isaatiin akka ta'e shakku, kunis gocha hammeenyaa ykn sabootaajii ta'uu isaa mirkaneessuuf qorannoon eegalameera.

title: US court rejects Trump’s emergency order keeping Michigan coal plant open
english: A federal appeals court has ruled that the U.S. Energy Department overstepped its legal authority by forcing a Michigan coal plant to stay open past its planned retirement date. The court decided there was no legitimate emergency to justify keeping the old facility running, noting that such powers should only be used as a last resort. This decision challenges the Trump administration's efforts to maintain aging coal plants, potentially shifting the focus back to the original plan to decommission the site.
amharic: የፌዴራል ይግባኝ ሰሚ ፍርድ ቤት የአሜሪካ የኢነርጂ መምሪያ በቴክኒክና ህጋዊ ስልጣኑን በመሻገር የሚቺጋን የድንጋይ ከሰል ማመንጫ ጣቢያ ከተያዘለት የጡረታ ጊዜ በላይ እንዲቀጥል ማዘዙን ውድቅ አድርጎታል። ፍርድ ቤቱ ይህንን ያረጀ ጣቢያ ለማቆየት በቂ የሆነ የድንገተኛ ሁኔታ አለመኖሩን ገልጾ፣ የኢነርጂ መምሪያው የወሰደው እርምጃ ህገ-ወጥ መሆኑን አስታውቋል። ይህ ውሳኔ የትራምፕ አስተዳደር አሮጌ የድንጋይ ከሰል ጣቢያዎችን ለመጠበቅ የሚያደርጉትን ጥረት እንቅፋት የፈጠረበት ሲሆን፣ የጣቢያውን መዘጋት ሂደት ወደ ቀድሞ ሁኔታው ሊመልሰው ይችላል።
oromo: Mana murtii ol’aanaa federaalaa, ministeerri anniisaa Ameerikaa buufata anniisaa gaazii dhagaa (coal) kan Michigan yeroo beellama isaa dura akka hojii itti fufu ajajuun isaa aangoo isaa darbuu ta’uu murteesse. Mana murtichaa buufata kana hojii irra tursiisuuf haala ariifachiisaa ta’e tokkollee akka hin jirre ibseera. Murteen kun yaalii mootummaan Traamp buufataalee anniisaa dulloomanii turan tursiisuuf godhaa jiru kan mormu yoo ta’u, buufatichi cufamuuf karoorfame ture akka cufamuuf karaa bana.

title: At least seven killed in fire at prison in northern Syria
english: A fire at a prison in Kobane, northern Syria, has resulted in the deaths of at least seven inmates and left many others injured. The incident occurred during a riot that followed public protests over the recent killing of a former Kurdish fighter. While the official cause of the blaze remains under investigation, the event underscores ongoing instability and regional tensions in the country following the change in national leadership.
amharic: በሰሜናዊ ሶሪያ ኮባኒ ከተማ በሚገኝ እስር ቤት በተነሳ እሳት ቢያንስ ሰባት እስረኞች ህይወታቸው አልፏል፣ በርካቶችም ጉዳት ደርሶባቸዋል። የእሳቱ አደጋ የተከሰተው የቀድሞ የኩርድ ታጋይ መገደልን ተከትሎ በተቀሰቀሰው ተቃውሞ እና ተያይዞ በተነሳው ሁከት ነው። የእሳቱ ትክክለኛ መንስኤ በምርመራ ላይ ቢሆንም፣ ይህ ክስተት በሶሪያ በፖለቲካዊ ለውጥ ማግስት እየተስተዋለ ያለውን አለመረጋጋት እና ውጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Magala Kobaanee kan kibba Siiriyaatti argamtu keessatti mana hidhaa tokko keessatti ibidda kaeen lubbuun namoota yoo xiqqaate torba darbeera, hedduunis miidhaniiru. Ibidni kun kan ka'e, ajjeechaa qabsaa'aa Kooridii kanaan walqabatee mormii fi jeequmsa uumame booda dha. Sababni dhugaan ibidda kanaa ammallee qulqullaa'aa kan jiru yoo ta'u, taateen kun jijjiirama siyaasaa biyyattii booda rakkoolee nageenyaa fi walitti bu'iinsa jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Danish FA allege FIFA Legal Committee evaded questions on Infantino’s plan
english: The head of the Danish Football Association, Jesper Moller, has criticized FIFA for failing to address serious questions regarding a controversial plan to sell commercial rights to major tournaments. Moller expressed frustration that the FIFA Legal Committee avoided discussing this issue, further damaging his confidence in the organization's current leadership. Consequently, the Danish FA is actively seeking a new candidate to challenge Gianni Infantino in the upcoming presidential election.
amharic: የዴንማርክ እግር ኳስ ማህበር ፕሬዝዳንት የሆኑት ጄስፐር ሞለር፣ የፊፋ የህግ ኮሚቴ ለትላልቅ ውድድሮች የንግድ መብቶችን ለመሸጥ በታቀደው አወዛጋቢ እቅድ ዙሪያ ለቀረቡ ጥያቄዎች ምላሽ ባለመስጠቱ ትችት ሰንዝረዋል። ሞለር ጉዳዩ በህግ ኮሚቴው ሳይወያይ መቅረቱ ቅር እንዳሰኘው በመግለጽ፣ አሁን ያለው የፊፋ አመራር እምነት የሚጣልበት አይደለም ብለዋል። በዚህም የተነሳ የዴንማርክ እግር ኳስ ማህበር በሚቀጥለው የፊፋ ፕሬዝዳንታዊ ምርጫ በጂያኒ ኢንፋንቲኖ ላይ የሚወዳደር አዲስ እጩ እየፈለጉ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Federeeshinii Kubbaa Miillaa Denmaark, Jesper Moller, koomiteen seeraa FIFA karoora biyyattii irratti dhiibbaa uumuu danda'u kan waldaa kubbaa miillaa gurguruu ilaalchisee gaaffiiwwan ka'aniif deebii kennuu dhiisuu isaa balaaleffataniiru. Gaggeessaan kun dhimmi kun gadi fageenyaan akka hin mari'atamne taasifamuun isaa amantaa inni FIFA irratti qabu akka hir'ise ibsaniiru. Kana irraa kan ka'e, federeeshiniin Denmaark filannoo prezidaantummaa FIFA dhufu irratti gita gaarii kan ta'e dorgomaa biraa barbaacha jira.

title: Police in Barcelona clash with Catalan national day activists
english: In Barcelona, security forces were involved in a physical altercation with protesters celebrating Catalonia's national day. The demonstration, which is an annual event, saw tensions rise between the local authorities and activists. Although the provided text mentions the conflict, it does not detail specific injuries or the exact reasons behind the physical confrontation.
amharic: በባርሴሎና ከተማ የካታሎን ብሔራዊ ቀንን ምክንያት በማድረግ በተደረገ ሰልፍ ላይ ከፖሊስ ጋር ግጭት ተፈጥሯል። ይህ በየዓመቱ የሚከበረው ዝግጅት በፀጥታ አካላት እና በተቃዋሚዎች መካከል ውጥረትን ቀስቅሷል። ምንም እንኳን ግጭቱ መፈጠሩ ቢገለጽም ስለ ጉዳት ወይም ስለ ግጭቱ መነሻ ዝርዝር መረጃ አልቀረበም።
oromo: Magala Barseeloonaa keessatti, guyyaa biyyaalessaa Kaatalaaniyaa kabajuuf hiriira bahanii turan irratti poolisii fi namoota hiriira bahan gidduutti walitti bu’iinsi uumameera. Walitti bu’iinsi kun kan uumame ta’us, miidhaan ga’ee fi sababni isaa ifatti hin ibsamne.

title: Iranian official tells Al Jazeera IAEA ruling was imposed by US and Israel
english: A senior Iranian spokesperson has rejected a recent IAEA resolution regarding the country's nuclear program, claiming it was forced upon the agency by the United States and Israel. Despite accusing these nations of ongoing military and economic hostility, the official stated that Iran remains willing to engage in diplomatic discussions. The statement highlights the growing tensions between Tehran and Western powers concerning nuclear oversight.
amharic: የኢራን የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስቴር ቃል አቀባይ የአቶሚክ ኢነርጂ ዓለም አቀፍ ኤጀንሲ (IAEA) በኢራን የኒውክሌር ፕሮግራም ላይ ያሳለፈውን ውሳኔ አሜሪካ እና እስራኤል ያስገደዱት ነው ሲሉ ገለጹ። ኢራን በአሜሪካ የኢኮኖሚ እና ወታደራዊ ጫና ውስጥ ብትሆንም ለዲፕሎማሲያዊ መፍትሄዎች ክፍት እንደሆነች አስታውቀዋል። ይህ መግለጫ በኢራን እና በምዕራባውያን ሀገራት መካከል ስላለው የኒውክሌር ውጥረት ያሳያል።
oromo: Dubbi himaan ministeera dhimma alaa Iraan, murteen dhaabbata anniisaa niwuukileeraa adunyaa (IAEA) sagantaa niwuukileeraa biyyattii irratti darbe, Ameerikaa fi Israa'el kan dirqisiisan akka ta'e ibsan. Iraan dhiibbaa diinagdee fi waraana Ameerikaa irraa ishee mudatuun kan beekamu ta'us, dhimmoota gama diplomasiitiin mari'achuuf fedhii akka qabdu beeksisaniiru. Ibsi kun walitti dhufeenya Iraanii fi biyyoota dhihaa gidduu jiru kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Ukraine faces 'toughest winter' since Russia's full-scale invasion, UN official tells BBC
english: A senior UN official has warned that Ukraine is entering its most difficult winter since the start of the full-scale Russian invasion. Persistent Russian strikes on energy infrastructure have created an urgent need for repairs to prevent a humanitarian disaster as temperatures drop. Both nations continue to intensify drone attacks, leading to rising civilian casualties and damage to essential facilities.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት ከፍተኛ ባለስልጣን እንደገለጹት ዩክሬን ከ2022 ጀምሮ ከነበረው ሁሉ እጅግ አስቸጋሪውን ክረምት እየገጠማት ነው። ሩሲያ በኃይል ማመንጫ ተቋማት ላይ እያደረሰች ያለው ጥቃት የሙቀት መጠኑ በሚቀንስበት ወቅት ሰብአዊ ቀውስ ሊያስከትል ይችላል የሚል ስጋት ፈጥሯል። ሁለቱም ሀገራት በድሮን ጥቃቶች ተባብረው በመቀጠላቸው በሰላማዊ ሰዎች ላይ ጉዳት እየደረሰ እና መሰረታዊ መሠረተ ልማቶች እየወደሙ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Hoggantoonni Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii akka ibsanitti, Yukreeniin weerarri Raashiyaan ishee irratti bante waggaa 2022 eegale kaasee yeroo gannaa cimaa ta'e keessa seenaa jirti. Raashiyaan bu'uuraalee misooma anniisaa irratti weerara gaggeessaa jirtuun, qorri yoo hammaatu balaan namoomaa ni mudata jedhamee sodaatama. Biyyoottan lamaanuu weerara doonii (drone) walitti fufiinsaan gaggeessaa waan jiraniif, miidhaan lubbuu fi qabeenyaa irratti ga'uufi jira.

title: 'It's like a dog set loose on us' - fear over Kenya's crackdown on foreign traders
english: Kenyan President William Ruto has ordered all foreign nationals running small businesses to shut down by September 7, arguing that these roles should be reserved for local citizens. This announcement has sparked widespread fear and harassment, leading many foreign workers to flee the country and causing family separations. As a result, immigrants are currently facing significant uncertainty and financial hardship, with many feeling forced to return to their home countries.
amharic: የኬንያው ፕሬዚዳንት ዊሊያም ሩቶ በሀገሪቱ ትንንሽ የንግድ ስራዎችን የሚሰሩ የውጭ ሀገር ዜጎች እስከ መስከረም 7 ድረስ ስራቸውን እንዲያቆሙ ትዕዛዝ ሰጥተዋል። ይህ ውሳኔ በውጭ ዜጎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋትና በደል እንዲደርስ በማድረጉ፣ ብዙዎች ሀገሪቱን ለቀው እንዲወጡና የቤተሰብ መለያየት እንዲከሰት አድርጓል። በዚህም ምክንያት የውጭ ዜጎች የገቢ ምንጫቸውን በማጣታቸው ለችግር የተጋለጡ ሲሆን፣ አብዛኞቹ ወደ ሀገራቸው ለመመለስ እየተገደዱ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Pirezedantiin Keeniyaa Wiliyaam Ruutoon, lammiileen biyya alaa gandoota keessatti daldala xixiqqaa gaggeessan hundi hanga Fulbaana 7tti akka cufan ajajaniiru. Murtii kanaan wal-qabatee, baqattoonniifi hojjettoonni biyya alaa sodaafi rakkina guddaaf saaxilamanii jiru. Kana irra kan ka'e, namoonni hedduu biyyattii gadi lakkisanii ba'aa jiran, kunis maatii hedduu wal-irraa fageesseera.

title: India’s Modi calls for empowerment of Global South at BRICS Summit
english: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi used the BRICS summit to advocate for a significant reform of international governance structures. He argued that developing nations currently lack influence over global policies that directly affect them. Modi proposed moving away from unequal power dynamics to create a more inclusive system for the Global South.

oromo: Ministirri Mummee Indiyaa Narendraa Moodi walga'ii goggoggii BRICS irratti akkaataa bulchiinsi addunyaa itti hoogganamu fooyya'uu akka qabu dubbataniiru. Biyyonni guddachaa jiran dhiibbaa isaanii irratti qabu irratti murtoo kennuuf carraa hin qaban jechuun himaniiru. Kanaafuu, sirna ammaa kana jijjiiruun biyyoota 'Global South' jedhaman hirmaachisaa ta'e uumuu akka qaban gaafataniiru.

title: Manchester United vs Man City: Premier League – predictions, teams, lineups
english: Manchester United will host Manchester City at Old Trafford this Sunday for the first derby of the 2026-27 Premier League season. City currently leads the league table under new manager Enzo Maresca, who is looking to maintain his strong start after replacing Pep Guardiola. Conversely, Michael Carrick’s Manchester United side is seeking consistency after an inconsistent beginning to their campaign.
amharic: የእንግሊዝ ፕሪሚየር ሊግ የመጀመሪያው የማንቸስተር ደርቢ ጨዋታ በዚህ እሁድ በኦልድ ትራፎርድ ማንቸስተር ዩናይትድ እና ማንቸስተር ሲቲን ያገናኛል። አዲሱ አሰልጣኝ ኢንዞ ማሬስካ ቡድኑን በመምራት ላይ ያሉት ማንቸስተር ሲቲዎች በሊጉ አናት ላይ ተቀምጠው ጥሩ የውድድር ዘመን ጀምረዋል። በሌላ በኩል ማይክል ካሪክ የሚመሩት ማንቸስተር ዩናይትዶች በውድድር ዘመኑ መጀመሪያ ላይ ባሳዩት ያልተረጋጋ አቋም ምክንያት በዚህ ትልቅ ጨዋታ ላይ ለውጥ ለማምጣት እየተጠባበቁ ነው።
oromo: Dilbata dhufu kana taphni dorgommii Maanchistar darbii kan jalqabaa akkaataa Premier League bara 2026-27 Old Trafford irratti Maanchistar Yuunaytid fi Maanchistar Siitii gidduutti geggeeffama. Maanchistar Siitii leenjisaa haaraa Enzo Maresca jalatti sadarkaa tokkoffaa irra jiru. Gama biraatiin, gareen Maanchistar Yuunaytid kan Michael Carrick leenjifamu, jalqaba dorgommii isaanii irratti walitti fufiinsa dhabuun booda tapha kana injifachuuf qophiirra jiru.

title: Trump: Iran probably ‘behind’ Saudi oil pipeline attack
english: Former US President Donald Trump stated that Iran was likely responsible for the attack on a Saudi Arabian oil pipeline that led to its temporary closure. He further noted that Houthi rebels have requested that the United States refrain from getting involved in the conflict in Yemen. These developments highlight ongoing tensions in the region concerning critical energy infrastructure.
amharic: የቀድሞው የአሜሪካ ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በሳውዲ አረቢያ የነዳጅ ማስተላለፊያ መስመር ላይ ለተፈፀመው ጥቃት ኢራን ተጠያቂ እንደሆነች ገልጸዋል። ይህ ጥቃት የነዳጅ ማስተላለፊያ መስመሩ ለጊዜው እንዲዘጋ አድርጓል። በተጨማሪም የሁቲ አማፂዎች አሜሪካ በየመን ግጭት ጣልቃ እንዳትገባ መጠየቃቸውን አክለዋል።
oromo: Pirezedaantiin duraanii Ameerikaa Donald Traamp, haleellaa boombii biyya Sa’ud Arabiyaa kanneen rurree boba’aa irratti raawwatamee fi qilleensicha akka cufamu godhe keessatti harka qabaachuu danda’uun Iranis himatanii jiru. Kana malees, qondaalli kun finxaaleyyiin Huutii mootummaan Ameerikaa dhimma Yaman keessa akka hin galle gaafachuu isaanii ibsaniiru. Kunis walitti bu’iinsa naannichaa fi nageenya sarara boba’aa irratti yaaddoo guddaa uumee jira.

title: Yemen government forces say Houthi ‘members, vehicles’ targeted in Mocha
english: Yemeni government forces have conducted airstrikes against Houthi fighters near the strategic port city of Mocha following the group's recent capture of key Red Sea coastal areas. This military escalation has worsened the humanitarian crisis, causing tens of thousands of people to flee their homes and hindering aid delivery. Tensions remain high as the fighting threatens critical shipping routes and regional stability.
amharic: የየመን የመንግስት ኃይሎች ሁቲ ታጣቂዎች ቁልፍ የሆነውን የቀይ ባህር የባህር ዳርቻ ከተማ መቆጣጠራቸውን ተከትሎ በአቅራቢያው በሚገኘው ሞቻ ከተማ የአየር ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን አስታውቀዋል። ይህ ወታደራዊ ግጭት የሰብአዊ ቀውሱን በማባባስ በአስር ሺዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ከቀያቸው እንዲፈናቀሉ ከማድረጉም በላይ የእርዳታ አቅርቦቶችን አስቸጋሪ አድርጎታል። ግጭቱ በአለም አቀፍ የባህር መስመሮች እና በክልሉ መረጋጋት ላይ ከፍተኛ ስጋት ደቅኗል።
oromo: Humnoonni mootummaa Yaman garee Houthii magaalaa buufata doonii Mochaa to'annoo isaanii jala galchuu isaanii hordofee, naannicha keessatti haleellaa qilleensa irraa raawwataniiru. Waraanni kun balaa namoomaa hammaatutti kan geessise yoo ta'u, namoonni kumni hedduun qe'ee isaanii irraa akka buqqa'anifi gargaarsi namoomaa akka danqamu taasiseera. Walitti bu'iinsi kun daandiiwwan bishaanii idil-addunyaa fi tasgabbii naannichaa irratti miidhaa cimaa geessisaa jira.

title: Left with nothing, people in Gaza are forced to rent generators by the hour
english: Due to the widespread destruction of infrastructure in Gaza, residents are currently unable to access electricity or running water. Families are now forced to pay high prices to rent mobile generators by the hour just to power water pumps for their homes. This difficult situation highlights the daily struggle of displaced people trying to survive in a region where basic municipal services have completely collapsed.
amharic: በጋዛ በደረሰው የመሠረተ ልማት ውድመት ምክንያት ነዋሪዎች የኤሌክትሪክ እና የውኃ አቅርቦት ማግኘት ተስኗቸዋል። ቤተሰቦች የውኃ ፓምፖቻቸውን ለማሰራት ብቻ በየሰዓቱ የሚከፈል ተንቀሳቃሽ ጄኔሬተር ለመከራየት ከፍተኛ ገንዘብ ለማውጣት ተገደዋል። ይህ አስቸጋሪ ሁኔታ የመሰረታዊ አገልግሎቶች ሙሉ በሙሉ በቆሙበት አካባቢ ተፈናቃዮች ለመኖር የሚያደርጉትን ዕለታዊ ትግል ያሳያል።
oromo: Gaazaatti miidhaan bu'uuraalee misoomaa irra ga'e, jiraattonni humna ibsaafi bishaan akka hin arganne taasiseera. Maatiin bishaan gara mana isaanii ol erguuf jecha, sa'aatiin kan kaffalamu jeneretaara itti fayyadamuuf dirqamaniiru. Haalli kun jiraattonni naannichaa tajaajila bu'uuraa dhabanii rakkoo cimaa keessa akka jiran kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Trump meeting Irish leader Micheál Martin during visit
english: Former US President Donald Trump has arrived in Ireland for a two-day visit, which includes a meeting with Prime Minister Micheál Martin. During his trip, he also held a courtesy meeting with President Catherine Connolly amid pressure for her to address the situation in Gaza. Beyond his official engagements, Trump plans to attend a golf tournament held at his own property in County Clare.
amharic: የቀድሞው የአሜሪካ ፕሬዚዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ የሁለት ቀን ጉብኝት ለማድረግ አየርላንድ ገብተዋል። በጉብኝታቸውም ከጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ሚሼል ማርቲን ጋር የተገናኙ ሲሆን፣ ከፕሬዚዳንት ካትሪን ኮኖሊ ጋርም አጭር ቆይታ አድርገዋል። በጋዛ ስላለው ሁኔታ ውይይት እንዲያደርጉ ግፊት ቢደረግም፣ ትራምፕ በቆይታቸው በራሳቸው የጎልፍ ሜዳ የሚካሄድ ውድድርን እንደሚታደሙ ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Pirezedantiin duraanii Ameerikaa Doonaald Tiraamp guyyoota lamaaf biyya Ayirlaand daawwachuuf achi ga'aniiru. Daawwannaa isaanii kanaanis muummee ministiraa biyyattii Micheál Martin waliin wal arganiiru. Kana malees, pirezedantii biyyattii Kaatiriin Konoolii waliin wal arguun kan jiru yoo ta'u, akkaataa waldhabdee Gaazaarrattis marii akka godhan dhiibbaan godhameera. Tiraamp daawwannaa isaanii kana gidduutti dorgommii ispoortii goolfii kan qabeenya isaanii ta'e irratti argamuuf karoorfataniiru.

title: 'Never, ever forget' - America marks 25th anniversary of 9/11 attacks
english: The United States recently observed the 25th anniversary of the September 11 terrorist attacks with solemn memorial ceremonies held at the World Trade Center, the Pentagon, and in Pennsylvania. Current and former U.S. leaders gathered to honor the nearly 3,000 victims by reading their names and observing moments of silence. These tributes served as a national reflection on the tragedy that fundamentally shaped modern American history and foreign policy.
amharic: አሜሪካ የሴፕቴምበር 11 የሽብር ጥቃት 25ኛ ዓመት መታሰቢያን በኒውዮርክ፣ በፔንታጎን እና በፔንሲልቬንያ በተካሄዱ ሥነ-ሥርዓቶች አከበረች። የአሁኑ እና የቀድሞ የአሜሪካ መሪዎች የተገኙባቸው እነዚህ ዝግጅቶች፣ በዕለቱ ህይወታቸውን ያጡ ወደ 3,000 የሚጠጉ ሰዎችን በስም በመጥራት እና በዝምታ በማሰብ ተካሂደዋል። ይህም አሜሪካውያን በታሪካቸው ጥልቅ ጠባሳ ጥሎ ያለፈውን ይህንን አሳዛኝ ክስተት ዳግም የሚያስታውሱበት ቀን ነበር።
oromo: Amerikaan ayyaana waggaa 25ffaa haleellaa shororkeessitoota guyyaa Ebla 11 (September 11) bakkeewwan haleellaan itti raawwatame kanneen akka World Trade Center, Pentagon fi Pennsylvania keessatti yaadatteetti. Hogganoonni Amerikaa kan ammaa fi kanaan dura turan aarsaa lubbuu namoota 3,000 ol darbe yaadachuuf walgahanii maqaa isaanii dubbisuu fi daqiiqaa muraasaaf callisuun kabajaniiru. Yaadannoon kun seenaa Amerikaa irratti dhiibbaa guddaa kan qabuu fi aarsaa guyyaa sanaa kan yaadachiisu ture.

title: 9/11 at 25: How the ‘War on Terror’ helped mainstream Europe’s far right
english: Twenty-five years after the 9/11 attacks, the 'War on Terror' has been identified as a key factor in boosting the political influence of far-right parties across Europe. While these groups were previously marginalized, global policies and media rhetoric following 2001 helped legitimize their anti-Muslim narratives. This shift allowed far-right movements to transform from fringe groups into credible, mainstream political contenders by framing Islam as a threat to Western society.
amharic: ከሴፕቴምበር 11 ጥቃት ሃያ አምስት ዓመታት በኋላ፣ 'የሽብርተኝነት ጦርነት' በአውሮፓ ውስጥ የጽንፈኛ ቀኝ ፓርቲዎች የፖለቲካ ተጽዕኖ እንዲያድግ ትልቅ ሚና እንደተጫወተ ተገልጿል። ከ2001 በኋላ የተወሰዱ ዓለም አቀፍ ፖሊሲዎች እና የሚዲያ ዘገባዎች በእስልምና ላይ ያነጣጠሩ የጥላቻ ንግግሮችን ህጋዊ በማድረግ እነዚህን ቡድኖች ከማህበረሰቡ ዳር የነበሩበትን ሁኔታ ቀይሮ ወደ ዋና የፖለቲካ መድረክ እንዲመጡ አስችሏቸዋል። በዚህም የተነሳ ጽንፈኛ ቡድኖች እስልምናን ለምዕራባውያን እሴቶች ስጋት አድርገው በመሳል ተቀባይነትን አግኝተዋል።
oromo: Hujii weerara gaafa Fulbaana 11 booda waggaa 25ffaatti, 'Waraanni Shoroorkeessummaa' gareewwan mirga-fago (far-right) Awurooppaa keessatti beekamtii fi humna akka argatan gargaaree jira. Duratti, gareewwan kun siyaasa guddaa keessatti bakka hin qaban turan; ta'us, duulaa fi siyaasa addunyaa sana booda ba'een, dubbii isaan Islaamummaa irratti qaban saba biratti fudhatama argate. Kanaanis, gareewwan kun Islaamummaa akka diina aadaa lixaa fi dimookiraasii tti gabaasuun, akka humna siyaasaa cimaatti of gurguruu danda'aniiru.

title: Guatemalan judge clears deputy minister, three leaders of terrorism charges
english: A Guatemalan judge has dismissed terrorism and other serious charges against Deputy Minister Luis Pacheco and three Indigenous leaders. The accusations stemmed from their involvement in 2023 protests against a prosecutor who was widely criticized for attempting to obstruct President Bernardo Arevalo’s inauguration. The case was dropped after prosecutors determined no laws were broken, marking a significant step against the previous administration's efforts to criminalize Indigenous activists.
amharic: የጓቲማላ ፍርድ ቤት ምክትል ሚኒስትር ሉዊስ ፓቼኮን እና ሶስት የአገሬው ተወላጅ መሪዎችን በሽብርተኝነት እና በሌሎች ወንጀሎች ተከሰው የነበሩበትን ክስ ውድቅ አድርጓል። ክሱ የቀረበው እ.ኤ.አ. በ2023 ፕሬዝዳንት በርናርዶ አሬቫሎ ስልጣን እንዳይረከቡ ለማድረግ ጥረት አድርገዋል ተብሎ በተከሰሰ አቃቤ ህግ ላይ በተካሄደ ተቃውሞ ውስጥ በመሳተፋቸው ነው። አቃቤ ህጎቹ የተከሳሾቹ ድርጊት ህገ-ወጥ አለመሆኑን በማረጋገጣቸው፣ ፍርድ ቤቱ ክሱን በይፋ ዘግቶታል።
oromo: Mana murtii Gwaatimaalaa, Ministira itti aanaa Luwiis Paachekoo fi hogganoota lammiiwwan gartuu durii afur irratti himannaa shororkeessummaa dabalatee dhiyaatee ture haqeera. Himannaan kun kan dhufe bara 2023, Preezdaant Barnaardoo Arrevaaloo aangoo akka hin qabanne gufachiisuuf yaalii godhan jedhaman, abbaa alangaa tokko irratti mormii gaggeeffame keessatti hirmaachuu isaaniitiini. Abbaan alangaa gochi isaanii seera cabsuu akka hin taane erga mirkaneessee booda, manni murtichaa himannicha balleessuun isaa mirga dimookiraasii fi hirmaannaa uummataa kan kabachiise ta'uun ibsameera.

title: Sweden heads to the polls: What’s at stake in the knife-edge election?
english: Sweden is holding a highly competitive general election this Sunday, where voters are deciding between a center-left coalition and a right-wing alliance that may formally include the Sweden Democrats for the first time. The election focuses on critical issues such as immigration, rising crime rates, and economic stability. Citizens will cast ballots for national, regional, and municipal representatives in a process that could significantly shift the country's political direction.
amharic: ስዊድን እሁድ ዕለት በከፍተኛ ፉክክር የታጀበ አጠቃላይ ምርጫ እያካሄደች ሲሆን፣ መራጮች በግራ ዘመም ጥምረት እና ለመጀመሪያ ጊዜ የሽዌድን ዴሞክራቶች ፓርቲን ሊያካትት በሚችል የቀኝ ዘመም ጥምረት መካከል ምርጫቸውን ያደርጋሉ። ምርጫው በስደት፣ በወንጀል መጠን መጨመር እና በኢኮኖሚ መረጋጋት ጉዳዮች ላይ ትኩረት ያደርጋል። ዜጎች ለሀገር አቀፍ፣ ለክልል እና ለከተማ ምክር ቤቶች ተወካዮቻቸውን የሚመርጡ ሲሆን፣ ይህ ምርጫ የአገሪቱን የፖለቲካ አቅጣጫ ሊቀይር እንደሚችል ይጠበቃል።
oromo: Swidin Dilbata dhufu kana filannoo waliigalaa cimaa ta'e geggeessuuf qophiirra jirti; filattoonnis garee hirmaattota bitaa fi mirgaa gidduutti filannoo taasisu. Filannoon kun dhimmoota akka godaantotaa, yakka dabalaa jiru fi tasgabbii dinagdee irratti xiyyeeffata. Lammiileen bakka buutota mootummaa, naannoo fi kantiibaa filachuuf sagalee kennuuf kan jiran yommuu ta'u, bu'aan filannoo kanaa gara fuulduraatti kallattii siyaasa biyyattii jijjiiruu danda'a.

title: Russia strikes cargo vessels, steel plants across Ukraine
english: Russian forces recently launched a series of airstrikes targeting steel plants and industrial facilities across several Ukrainian cities, including Zaporizhzhia and Dnipro. Additionally, two cargo ships were struck at a Black Sea port following a retaliatory Ukrainian drone attack on Russian manufacturing sites. These strikes reflect an ongoing cycle of mutual attacks on industrial and energy infrastructure that has persisted since the start of the war.
amharic: የሩሲያ ጦር በዛፖሪዢያ እና በዲኒፕሮን ጨምሮ በተለያዩ የዩክሬን ከተሞች በሚገኙ የብረት ማምረቻ ፋብሪካዎችና የኢንዱስትሪ ማዕከላት ላይ ጥቃት ሰንዝሯል። ይህ የሩሲያ ጥቃት የዩክሬን ድሮኖች በሩሲያ የኢንዱስትሪ ተቋማት ላይ ጥቃት መፈጸማቸውን ተከትሎ የመጣ ነው። ሁለቱ ሀገራት እርስ በርስ የሚፈጽሙት ይህ የኢንዱስትሪ እና የሃይል መሰረተ ልማቶች ላይ ያነጣጠረ ጥቃት ጦርነቱ ከጀመረበት ጊዜ አንስቶ እየተባባሰ ቀጥሏል።
oromo: Humnooti Raashiyaa magaalota Yukreen hedduu keessatti argaman dhaabbilee sibiilaa fi iddoowwan industirii irratti haleellaa raawwataniiru. Haleellaan Raashiyaa kun kan dhufeyyuu erga Yukreen buufatawwan industirii Raashiyaa irratti haleellaa xiyyaara nama malee (drone) gaggeessitee booda. Gamtaan lamaanuu bu'uuraalee industirii fi humna ibsaa irratti haleellaa wal-irraa hin cinne geggeessaa jiran kun hanga ammaa itti fufee jira.

title: Trump may be BRICS’s best recruitment agent
english: President Donald Trump's aggressive use of tariffs and economic pressure against BRICS members may inadvertently push these nations closer together. While the bloc faces significant internal political and regional divisions, Washington's reliance on economic coercion gives them a shared incentive to seek independence from US financial systems. Consequently, rather than weakening the group, American trade policies are actually encouraging these diverse nations to seek collective protection from global US influence.
amharic: ፕሬዝዳንት ዶናልድ ትራምፕ በብሪክስ አባል ሀገራት ላይ የሚጠቀሙበት የንግድ ታሪፍ እና የኢኮኖሚ ጫና፣ እነዚህን ሀገራት ሳይታሰበው ወደ አንድነት እያቀረባቸው ይገኛል። ብሪክስ ውስጥ የውስጥ የፖለቲካ እና የክልል ልዩነቶች ቢኖሩም፣ የአሜሪካ መንግስት ኢኮኖሚን እንደ መሳሪያ መጠቀሙ አባል ሀገራቱ ከአሜሪካ የፋይናንስ ስርዓት ነጻ መሆን እንዲፈልጉ እያደረጋቸው ነው። ስለዚህ፣ የትራምፕ የንግድ ፖሊሲ ቡድኑን ከማዳከም ይልቅ፣ እነዚህ የተለያዩ ሀገራት ከዩኤስ ተጽዕኖ ለመከላከል አብረው እንዲሰሩ ምክንያት እየሆነ ነው።
oromo: Prezidaant Donaald Tiraamp miseensota BRICS irratti gibira fi dhiibbaa diinagdee cimaa fayyadamuun isaanii, akkuma hin yaadamin biyyoota kana walitti dhiyeessaa jira. Gareen BRICS garaagarummaa siyaasaa fi naannoo hedduu qabaatus, gochi mootummaan Ameerikaa diinagdee akka meeshaatti itti fayyadamuu isaa biyyoonni kunneen sirna faayinaansii Ameerikaa irraa bilisa ta'uuf akka fedhan taasiseera. Kanaafuu, imaammanni daldalaa Tiraamp garee kana laaffisuu mannaa, biyyoonni gargar ta'an kunneen dhiibbaa Ameerikaa irraa of ittisuuf waliin hojjechuuf akka kaka'an gochaa jira.

title: Saudi Arabia shuts key oil pipeline after drone attack launched from Iraq
english: Saudi Arabia has suspended operations on a major oil pipeline following a drone attack that originated from Iraqi territory near the Iranian border. Iraq has launched an investigation and dismissed a military commander in response to the incident, which occurred during a period of heightened regional tensions. Although the pipeline is vital for global oil supply, Saudi Arabia has decided not to retaliate immediately to allow Iraqi authorities to address the security breach.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ ከኢራቅ ድንበር በተነሱ ድሮኖች የተፈጸመ ጥቃትን ተከትሎ ዋና የነዳጅ ማስተላለፊያ መስመሯን ዘግታለች። የኢራቅ መንግስት ጥቃቱ ከግዛቷ መፈጸሙን በማረጋገጥ ምርመራ መጀመሩንና አንድ ከፍተኛ ወታደራዊ አዛዥን ከስራ ማሰናበቱን አስታውቋል። ሳውዲ አረቢያ ለዓለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ አቅርቦት ወሳኝ የሆነውን መስመር ለጊዜው ብትዘጋውም፣ በኢራቅ በኩል ተገቢውን እርምጃ እንዲወሰድ በማሰብ ወዲያውኑ የበቀል እርምጃ ከመውሰድ ተቆጥባለች።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan miidhaa daangaa Iraaq irraa ka'anii weerara sibilbilootaan (drones) ishee irra ga'e hordofee, daandii boba'aa ishee ijoo ta'e tokko cufteetti. Mootummaan Iraaq weerarichi daangaa ishee irraa raawwatamuu mirkaneessuun, qorannoo eegaluu fi ajajaa waraanaa tokko hojii irraa ari'uu ishee beeksisteetti. Daandii boba'aa kana cufuu isaanii kan ibse ta'us, Saudii Arabiyaan mootummaan Iraaq rakkoo kana akka furuuf jechuun haaloo bahuu irraa of qusatteetti.

title: Death toll from Philippines ferry fire climbs to 35, with dozens still missing
english: A fire on a ferry near Coron, Philippines, has resulted in 35 confirmed deaths, with rescue teams still searching for over 50 missing passengers. The blaze broke out in the cargo area during a long journey from Manila, causing chaos as people struggled to evacuate. Authorities are now investigating the safety procedures and circumstances surrounding the disaster, as many victims were found in the ship's sleeping quarters.
amharic: በፊሊፒንስ በኮሮን አቅራቢያ በደረሰ የእሳት አደጋ በጀልባ ላይ የነበሩ 35 ሰዎች ህይወት አልፏል፤ ከ50 በላይ ተሳፋሪዎች አሁንም የገቡበት አልታወቀም። እሳቱ የተነሳው ከማኒላ ወደ መዳረሻቸው በሚጓዙበት ወቅት የካርጎ ክፍል ውስጥ ሲሆን፣ ድንገተኛው ሁኔታ ተሳፋሪዎች እንዲደናገጡ አድርጓል። ባለስልጣናት በአደጋው ወቅት የነበሩ የደህንነት ጉድለቶችን እና የደረሰውን ጥፋት ምክንያት እያጣሩ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Filippiinitti markaba bakka tuuristotaa 'Coron' jedhamutti ibidda qabateen namoonni 35 lubbuun isaanii darbeera, akkasumas namoonni 50 ol ta'an hanga ammaatti eessa akka ga'an hin beekamu. Ibiddis markabatti gara kaargootti erga ka'ee booda, namoonni hedduun bakka ciisichaatti lubbuun isaanii darbeera. Abbootiin taayitaa haala balaa kanaa fi seera eegumsa markabichaa irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jiru.

title: Chileans clash over 9/11 military coup legacy
english: Protesters and police clashed in Chile during events marking the 53rd anniversary of the military coup that ousted Salvador Allende. Citizens are expressing deep concern over perceived efforts by the current government to restore the reputation of dictator Augusto Pinochet. This event remains a highly divisive topic in the country, highlighting ongoing tensions regarding Chile's political history.
amharic: የቺሊ ዜጎች ሳልቫዶር አሌንዴን ከስልጣን ባስወገደው ወታደራዊ መፈንቅለ መንግስት 53ኛ ዓመት በዓል ላይ ከፖሊስ ጋር ተጋጭተዋል። ብዙዎች አሁን ያለው መንግስት የዲክታተሩን የአውጉስቶ ፒኖቼን ስም ለመመለስ እየሞከረ ነው ብለው በመስጋታቸው ተቃውሞ አሰምተዋል። ይህ ጉዳይ በሀገሪቱ ታሪክ ዙሪያ ያለውን መለያየት እና ውጥረት እንደገና አሳይቷል።
oromo: Namoonni biyya Chile, yaadannoo waggaa 53ffaa fonqolcha mootummaa Salvador Allende irratti gaggeeffamee irratti poolisoota wajjin walitti bu'aniiru. Ummanni hedduun mootummaan yeroo ammaa jiru aangoo isaanii fayyadamuun maqaa diktaatara Augusto Pinochet deebisanii bareechuuf yaalaa jiraachuu isaatti mufataniiru. Taateen kun seenaa siyaasaa biyyattii irratti har'as hangam akka wal-qoqqodinsa uumee jiru kan mul'isu dha.

title: BRICS meets in India: What’s on the agenda, why it matters
english: India is hosting the 18th BRICS summit in New Delhi, bringing together world leaders to discuss global economic issues and geopolitical tensions. The bloc, often seen as a counterweight to Western-led alliances, faces internal challenges regarding conflicts like the war in Ukraine and regional tensions in the Middle East. Despite these disagreements, the meeting focuses on strengthening cooperation among its expanded membership of major emerging economies.
amharic: ህንድ በኒው ዴልሂ የ18ኛው የብሪክስ (BRICS) የመሪዎች ጉባኤን እያስተናገደች ሲሆን፣ የዓለም መሪዎች በዓለም አቀፍ ኢኮኖሚ እና በጂኦፖለቲካዊ ጉዳዮች ላይ እየመከሩ ይገኛሉ። እንደ ምዕራባውያን አገራት መድረኮች አማራጭ የሚታየው ይህ ቡድን፣ በዩክሬን ጦርነት እና በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ውጥረት ሳቢያ በውስጡ የተወሰኑ አለመግባባቶች ይስተዋሉበታል። ሆኖም መሪዎቹ በአባል አገራቱ መካከል ያለውን የኢኮኖሚ ትብብር ለማጠናከር ትኩረት ሰጥተዋል።
oromo: Indiyaan gola gaggeessitoota BRICS kan 18ffaa Niyuudelhiitti keessummeessaa jirti. Gaggeessitoonni biyyoota addunyaa dhimmoota dinagdee fi siyaasa biyyoolessa irratti mari'achaa jiru. Gareen BRICS kun dhaabbata dhihaaf morkataa ta'e kan ilaalamu yoo ta'u, rakkoolee akka waraana Yukreen fi walitti bu'iinsa giddu galeessa bahaa ilaalchisee yaada garaagaraa qaba. Haata'u malee, mariin kun miseensota isaa gidduutti walitti dhufeenya dinagdee cimsuu irratti xiyyeeffata.

title: ‘The family paid the price’: India’s deadly online gambling crisis
english: In India, the rise of online gambling has led to severe financial instability and tragic consequences for many families. One recent case involved a young man and his parents who took their own lives after struggling with massive debts caused by his addiction to betting apps. Despite government bans on monetary online gaming, these platforms continue to operate illegally and attract millions of vulnerable users, highlighting a critical public safety crisis.
amharic: በህንድ እየተስፋፋ የመጣው የኦንላይን ቁማር ለበርካታ ቤተሰቦች ከባድ የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ እና አሳዛኝ የህይወት መጥፋት እያስከተለ ይገኛል። በቅርቡ አንድ ወጣት እና ወላጆቹ በቁማር ሱሰኝነት ምክንያት በተጠራቀመ ከፍተኛ ዕዳ ተስፋ በመቁረጥ ህይወታቸውን በራሳቸው አጥፍተዋል። መንግስት በገንዘብ ላይ የተመሰረተ የኦንላይን ጨዋታዎችን በህግ ቢከለክልም፣ ህገ-ወጥ የቁማር መተግበሪያዎች ስራቸውን በመቀጠል በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎችን ለከፍተኛ አደጋ እየዳረጉ ይገኛል።
oromo: Indiyaa keessatti babal'achuun taphoota garambaa ykn 'gambling' karaa intarneetii maatiiwwan hedduuf miidhaa dinagdee fi balaa lubbuu oolchuutti fufeera. Dhiheenya kana dargaggeessi tokko maatii isaa waliin ta'uun, liqii guddaa tapha kanaan irratti kuufameen booda of ajjeesuun oduu gaddisiisaa ta'e dhaga'ameera. Mootummaan taphoota maallaqaan taphataman irratti dhorkaa kaa'us, appileen kun ammas karaa seeraan alaa hojjechaa waan jiraniif, namoonni miliyoonaan lakkaawwaman balaa kanaaf saaxilamanii jiru.

title: China’s Xi heads to India for BRICS summit overshadowed by wars
english: Chinese President Xi Jinping has traveled to India to participate in the BRICS summit, where leaders will address global crises including the ongoing wars in Ukraine and the Middle East. This meeting marks Xi’s first visit to India in several years and serves as a significant attempt to improve diplomatic relations between the two nations following past border conflicts. While both countries are working toward better cooperation, their relationship remains complex due to persistent territorial disputes and underlying strategic competition.
amharic: የቻይናው ፕሬዝዳንት ዢ ጂንፒንግ በዩክሬን እና በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ ያሉ ጦርነቶችን ጨምሮ የተለያዩ ዓለም አቀፍ ጉዳዮችን ለመወያየት በህንድ ለሚካሄደው የብሪክስ (BRICS) ጉባኤ ተገኝተዋል። ይህ ጉብኝት የሁለቱ አገራት የድንበር ግጭት ከተፈጠረ በኋላ ግንኙነታቸውን ለማሻሻል የሚያደርጉት ትልቅ ጥረት ተደርጎ ታይቷል። ምንም እንኳን የሁለቱ ሀገራት የዲፕሎማሲ ግንኙነት እየተሻሻለ ቢመጣም፣ በግዛታዊ ክርክር እና በስልታዊ ውድድር ምክንያት አለመተማመኖች አሁንም አሉ።
oromo: Pirezidaantiin Chaayinaa Xi Jiinpiingi, walgahii BRICS kan Itoophiyaa keessatti gaggeeffamu irratti hirmaachuuf gara Indiyaa imalaniiru; walgahiin kun waraana Yuukireenii fi giddu-galeessa bahaa dabalatee dhimmoota addunyaa irratti kan xiyyeeffatu ta'a. Imalli kun erga waraana daangaa booda walitti dhufeenya biyyoota lamaanii fooyyessuuf yaalii guddaa kan agarsiisuudha. Haata'u malee, falmii daangaa fi dorgommii tarsiimawaa jiruun walqabatee walitti dhufeenyi biyyoota lamaanii ammas rakkoo keessa jira.

title: A stable Afghanistan post 9/11 is in US interests says former US diplomat
english: Former US diplomat Zalmay Khalilzad emphasizes that maintaining stability in Afghanistan remains vital for American security interests. He argues that the US must prevent the country from becoming a safe haven for groups that threaten the United States. Additionally, Khalilzad suggests that US foreign policy should prioritize limiting the expanding geopolitical influence of China and Russia.
amharic: የቀድሞው የአሜሪካ ዲፕሎማት ዘልማይ ካሊልዛድ በአፍጋኒስታን ውስጥ መረጋጋትን ማስፈን ለአሜሪካ ደህንነት ወሳኝ መሆኑን ገልጸዋል። አፍጋኒስታን በአሜሪካ ላይ ጥቃት የሚያደርሱ ቡድኖች መፈልፈያ እንዳትሆን መከላከል እንደሚያስፈልግ አስረድተዋል። በተጨማሪም የአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ የቻይናን እና የሩሲያን ተፅእኖ መግታት ላይ ትኩረት ማድረግ እንዳለበት ጠቁመዋል።
oromo: Diplomaatni Amerikaa duraanii Zalmay Khalilzad, tasgabbii Afgaanistaan keessatti mirkaneessuun fedhii nageenya Amerikaaf baay'ee barbaachisaa akka ta'e ibsan. Amerikaan biyyattiin garee ishee irratti xiyyeeffatan kanneeniif bakka buufata akka hin taane ittisuu qabdi jedhan. Kana malees, siyaasni alaa Amerikaa dhiibbaa biyyoota akka Chaayinaa fi Raashiyaa kan bal'achaa jiru xiqqeessuu irratti xiyyeeffachuu akka qabu eeraniiru.

title: Tragic death of woman who testified against father in notorious mafia murder of mother
english: Denise Cosco, who bravely testified against her father for the mafia-related murder of her mother in 2009, has died by suicide at age 35. Despite living under state protection for years, she struggled with the deep emotional trauma and complex family ties caused by her father's criminal legacy. Her passing serves as a tragic reminder of the lasting mental health impacts faced by those who turn against organized crime syndicates.
amharic: እ.ኤ.አ. በ2009 እናቷን በገደለው አባቷ ላይ ምስክርነት የሰጠችው ዴኒስ ኮስኮ በ35 ዓመቷ ራሷን አጠፋች። ለብዙ ዓመታት በመንግስት ጥበቃ ስር ብትኖርም፣ በአባቷ የወንጀል ድርጊት ምክንያት የደረሰባትን ከባድ የስነ-ልቦና ቀውስ እና የቤተሰብ እሰር ማሸነፍ ተስኗት ነበር። ሞቷ፣ በማፊያ ቡድኖች ላይ ለሚመሰክሩ ሰዎች የሚደረገው የረጅም ጊዜ የስነ-ልቦና ድጋፍ ምን ያህል አስፈላጊ እንደሆነ አሳዛኝ ማሳያ ሆኗል።
oromo: Dubartiin bara 2009 haadha ishee ajjeese jechuun abbaa ishee irratti ragaa baate, Deenis Koskoo, umurii waggaa 35tti of ajjeesite. Waggoota hedduuf eegumsa mootummaa jalatti kan jiraatte ta'us, miidhaa sammuu abbaa ishee irraa ishee ga'eefi qormaata maatii ishee mo'achuun ishee rakkisee ture. Duuti ishee kun, namoonni garee yakkaatiin falman jireenya isaanii guutuu deeggarsa sammuu akka barbaadan kan agarsiisuudha.

title: Passenger train derails in France leaving at least 44 injured
english: A passenger train traveling between Rouen and Caen in northern France derailed, resulting in injuries to at least 44 people. One young woman remains in critical condition following the accident, which involved approximately 180 passengers. Emergency responders have been deployed to the site near Cléon, and authorities are currently investigating the cause of the crash.
amharic: በሰሜን ፈረንሳይ በሩየን እና በካን ከተሞች መካከል ይጓዝ የነበረ የባቡር ትራንስፖርት ከሀዲዱ በመውጣቱ ቢያንስ 44 ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። ከአደጋው በኋላ አንዲት ወጣት በከባድ ሁኔታ ሆስፒታል የገባች ሲሆን በአጠቃላይ 180 መንገደኞች በባቡሩ ውስጥ ነበሩ። የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች ወደ ስፍራው የተሰማሩ ሲሆን ባለስልጣናት የአደጋውን መንስኤ ለማጣራት ምርመራ ጀምረዋል።
oromo: Faransaayi kaabaatti baaburri imaltootaa magaalaalee Rouen fi Caen gidduutti deemu tokko karaa irraa waan baheef namoonni 44 ol ta’an miidhaniiru. Imaltoota 180 keessaa dargaggeettiin tokko haala cimaa keessa kan jirtu yoo tahu, gareen gargaarsa hatattamaa gara iddoo balaa kanaatti bobbaaniiru. Abbootiin taayitaa balaa kana hordofee sababa inni itti uumame qorachaa jiru.

title: Arrest made over the death of black woman found hanged from tree
english: Police in Mississippi have arrested 51-year-old Jarques Ratliff and charged him with the murder of Tasia Fortune, a Black woman discovered hanged in Jackson last month. Authorities confirmed the death is being investigated as a homicide and indicated that more arrests may follow as the inquiry continues. While the victim's mother expressed a small sense of relief, the community remains deeply concerned due to the city's history of racial violence and initial frustrations over the police investigation's pace.
amharic: የሚሲሲፒ ፖሊስ ባለፈው ወር በጃክሰን ከተማ ዛፍ ላይ ተንጠልጥላ የተገኘችውን ታሲያ ፎርቹን በተባለች ጥቁር ሴት ግድያ ወንጀል የ51 ዓመቱን ጃርኩዌስ ራትሊፍ በቁጥጥር ስር አውለዋል። ባለስልጣናት የሴትየዋ ሞት ግድያ መሆኑን አረጋግጠው፣ ምርመራው እንደቀጠለ በመሆኑ ተጨማሪ ሰዎች ሊታሰሩ እንደሚችሉ ገልጸዋል። የግድያው ሁኔታ በከተማው ነዋሪዎች ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ስጋት የፈጠረ ሲሆን፣ የሟች እናት በቁጥጥር ስር መዋሉ እፎይታ ቢሰጣቸውም፣ የፖሊስ ምርመራ ቀደም ብሎ በነበረው የዝግታ ሂደት ቅሬታቸውን ሲገልጹ ቆይተዋል።
oromo: Poolisiin naannoo Mississippi namicha umriin isaa 51 ta'e Jarques Ratliff jedhamu, ajjeechaa Tasiya Forchuun jedhamtu kan ji'a darbe magaalaa Jaaksonitti muka irratti fannifamtee argamte irratti himatee to'annoo jala oolche. Aangonni akka ibsanitti duuti ishee kun ajjeechaa akka ta'e mirkanaa'eera, qorannoon itti fufee waan jiruufis namoonni biroo akka qabaman ibsameera. Ajjeechaan kun hawaasa keessatti sodaa guddaa kan uume yoo ta'u, haati ishee to'annoo jala oolchuun isaa tasgabbii xinnoo akka isheedhaaf kenne ibsitee jirti; ta'us, qorannoo poolisii dursee turee irratti komiin jiraachuun isaa ni beekama.

title: Passenger train derails in France, leaving 44 injured, 1 critical
english: A passenger train traveling between Rouen and Caen in northwestern France derailed on Friday, leaving 44 people injured. One individual remains in critical condition and was airlifted to a hospital, while emergency crews have secured the scene. Authorities have suspended rail traffic in the area and are currently investigating the cause of the accident.
amharic: በሰሜን ምዕራብ ፈረንሳይ በሮየን እና በካን ከተሞች መካከል ሲጓዝ የነበረ የባቡር ተሳፋሪዎች ከሀዲዱ በመውጣቱ 44 ሰዎች ቆስለዋል። አንዲት ወጣት በከባድ ሁኔታ ላይ በመሆኗ በሄሊኮፕተር ወደ ሆስፒታል የተወሰደች ሲሆን፣ የአደጋ ጊዜ ሰራተኞች በቦታው ተገኝተው ድጋፍ እየሰጡ ይገኛል። የባቡር አገልግሎቱ ለጊዜው የተቋረጠ ሲሆን ባለስልጣናት የአደጋውን መንስኤ ለማወቅ ምርመራ ጀምረዋል።
oromo: Faransaatti baaburri abbaa manaa Rouen fi Caen gidduutti imalaa ture kaadidoo irraa gombifamuun namoota 44 miidheera. Namni tokko haala hamaa keessa waan jiruuf xiyyaaraan gara hospitaalaatti ergamuu fi gargaarsi ariifachiisaan tasifamuu gabaafameera. Tajaajilli baaburaa iddoo sanatti dhaabbatee jiraachuu fi aangotni dhimma kana irratti qorannoo eegaluu beekameera.

title: Former top US diplomat reveals mistakes made after 9/11 attacks
english: Former senior diplomat Zalmay Khalilzad reflected on the 25th anniversary of the 9/11 attacks by identifying critical errors in U.S. foreign policy. He explained that a climate of intense national anger and fear following the attacks pressured the government into impulsive military decisions. Khalilzad specifically noted that rejecting early negotiations with the Taliban was a major missed opportunity that prolonged the conflict for two decades.
amharic: ቀድሞ የነበሩት ከፍተኛ ዲፕሎማት ዘልመይ ካሊልዛድ የሴፕቴምበር 11 ጥቃት 25ኛ ዓመት መታሰቢያን ምክንያት በማድረግ በአሜሪካ የውጭ ጉዳይ ፖሊሲ ላይ የተፈጸሙ ስህተቶችን ገምግመዋል። ጥቃቱን ተከትሎ በሀገሪቱ የነበረው ከፍተኛ ቁጣና ስጋት መንግስትን ወደ ፈጣንና ያልታሰቡ ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች እንደገፋው ተናግረዋል። በተለይም በወቅቱ ከታሊባን ጋር ድርድር ላለማድረግ የተወሰነው ውሳኔ ትልቅ ዕድልን ያሳለፈና ጦርነቱ ለሁለት አስርት ዓመታት እንዲራዘም ያደረገ ስህተት እንደነበር ገልጸዋል።
oromo: Diplomaatichi olaanaa turan Zalmay Khalilzad, yaadannoo waggaa 25ffaa haleellaa Sadaasa 11 irratti akka ibsanitti, siyaasni alaa Ameerikaa yeroo sana dogoggoroota gurguddoo qaba ture. Haleellaa sana booda aariin biyya keessaa fi sodaan cimaan mootummaan tarkaanfii waraanaa ariifataa fi hin yaadamne akka fudhatu godheera jedhaniiru. Keessattuu, jalqaba irratti garee Taaliiban waliin mari’achuu diduun carraa guddaa badee fi waraanichi waggoota 20f akka dheeratu taasiseera jechuun ibsaniiru.

title: Iran war live: Houthis control Red Sea coast, Saudi pipeline shut down
english: Houthi forces have gained total control over the Red Sea coastline in Yemen after quickly advancing against government troops. In a separate development, Saudi Arabia halted operations on its primary oil pipeline following a drone strike that was launched from within Iraq. The Iraqi government has launched an investigation and dismissed a military commander in response to the attack.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በመንግስት ኃይሎች ላይ ባደረጉት ፈጣን ጥቃት የየመንን የቀይ ባህር የባህር ዳርቻ ሙሉ በሙሉ መቆጣጠር ችለዋል። በተመሳሳይ፣ ሳውዲ አረቢያ ከኢራቅ በተነሱ ድሮኖች የተፈጸመባትን ጥቃት ተከትሎ ዋናውን የነዳጅ ማስተላለፊያ መስመር በጊዜያዊነት ዘግታለች። የኢራቅ መንግስት ጥቃቱን ተከትሎ ምርመራ የጀመረ ሲሆን አንድ የጦር አዛዥንም ከስልጣን አንስቷል።
oromo: Humnoonni Huutii mootummaa Yemenirratti tarkaanfii ariifataa fudhachuun daangaa galaana diimaa guutummaatti to'ataniiru. Gama biraatiin, Sa'udii Arabiyaan mi'a xiyyaaraa kanaan dura Iraaq irraa ka'een boombii ergameef erga rukutamtee booda, gaazii ishee erguu dhaabdeetti. Mootummaan Iraaqis qorannoo eegaluun ajajaa waraanaa tokko hojiirraa ari'eera.

title: UN extends partial Sudan arms embargo for a month
english: The UN Security Council has unanimously agreed to extend the existing arms embargo on Sudan's Darfur region for one month. This short-term measure provides additional time for members to discuss a US-led proposal to enforce a nationwide arms ban aimed at curbing the ongoing civil conflict. However, the plan faces significant opposition from Russia, which has vowed to block any expansion of the sanctions beyond the Darfur area.
amharic: የተባበሩት መንግስታት የፀጥታው ምክር ቤት በሱዳን ዳርፉር ክልል ላይ ሲጣል የነበረውን የጦር መሳሪያ እገዳ ለአንድ ወር ለማራዘም በአንድ ድምፅ ወስኗል። ይህ አጭር ጊዜ ለሀገሪቱ በሙሉ የጦር መሳሪያ እገዳ ለመጣል በአሜሪካ የቀረበውን ሀሳብ ለመወያየት ተጨማሪ ጊዜ ይሰጣል። ይሁን እንጂ ሩሲያ ማዕቀቡ ከዳርፉር ውጭ እንዲስፋፋ እንደማትፈቅድ በመግለጿ በጉዳዩ ላይ አለመግባባቶች አሉ።
oromo: Manni Maree Nageenyaa Dhaabbata Mootummoota Gamtoomanii naannoo Daarfuritti meeshaalee waraanaa galchu irratti dhorkaa ture ji'a tokkoof dheeressuuf sagalee tokkoon murteesseera. Murteen kun biyyattii guutuutti dhorkaa meeshaalee waraanaa hojiirra oolchuuf yaadni Ameerikaan dhiyeessite akka mariatamuuf yeroo dabalata. Haa ta'u malee, Rashiyaan dhorkaan kun naannoo Daarfurii ol akka hin babal'anne waan mormiteef, mariin kun rakkoo keessa jira.

title: Flavio Bolsonaro faces corruption probe weeks before Brazil election
english: Senator Flavio Bolsonaro is currently being investigated for alleged corruption, money laundering, and tax evasion linked to a major financial scandal involving banker Daniel Vorcaro. Authorities are examining suspicious fund transfers to a film project associated with the Bolsonaro family that may be tied to Vorcaro's fraudulent banking activities. These legal developments occur just before the upcoming presidential election, placing significant pressure on the senator's campaign.
amharic: ሴናተር ፍላቪዮ ቦልሶናሮ ከባንክ ሰራተኛ ዳንኤል ቮርካሮ ጋር በተያያዘ በተፈጠረ የሙስና፣ የገንዘብ ማጠብ እና የግብር ማጭበርበር ወንጀል ምርመራ እየተደረገባቸው ይገኛል። ባለስልጣናት በቦልሶናሮ ቤተሰብ የፊልም ፕሮጀክት ላይ የተደረገ ጥርጣሬ ያለበት የገንዘብ ዝውውር ከባንክ ማጭበርበሩ ጋር የተያያዘ መሆኑን እያጣሩ ነው። ይህ ህጋዊ ሂደት በምርጫው ዋዜማ እየተካሄደ መሆኑ ለሴናተሩ የፖለቲካ ዘመቻ ትልቅ ፈተና ሆኗል።
oromo: Senator Flavio Bolsonaro yakka malaammaltummaa, maallaqa seeraan ala dhiqachuu fi gibira baqachuu jedhuun qorannoon irratti banameera; kunis kan walqabatu hojjettaa baankii duraanii Daniel Vorcaro waliin dha. Qorattoonni maallaqni gara pirojektii fiilmii maatii Bolsonaro biratti ergame sun gocha farra-seeraa baankicha waliin walqabatuu fi dhiisuu isaa sakatta'aa jiru. Adeemsi seeraa kun filannoo biyyattii dura guyyoota muraasa keessa dhufuun isaa, duula siyaasaa senatarichaa irratti dhiibbaa cimaa uumee jira.

title: Israeli demolitions threaten schools and homes in Masafer Yatta
english: Israeli authorities have intensified demolition operations in Masafer Yatta, destroying Palestinian homes, essential water infrastructure, and solar panels. These actions have also targeted local schools, with military bulldozers damaging classrooms despite pleas from educators and the United Nations. Families in the region remain in a state of constant instability as they struggle to maintain their right to education and housing under restrictive Israeli planning policies.
amharic: የእስራኤል ባለስልጣናት በማሳፈር ያታ አካባቢ የፍልስጤማውያንን መኖሪያ ቤቶች፣ የውሃ መሰረተ ልማቶችን እና የፀሐይ ኃይል ማመንጫዎችን በማፍረስ ላይ ይገኛሉ። እነዚህ ድርጊቶች ትምህርት ቤቶችንም ያካተቱ ሲሆን፣ ወታደራዊ ቡልዶዘሮች የትምህርት ክፍሎችን አውድመዋል። በአካባቢው የሚገኙ ቤተሰቦች በእስራኤል የግንባታ ፖሊሲዎች ሳቢያ የመኖሪያ ቤት እና የትምህርት መብታቸውን ለማስከበር ከፍተኛ ፈተና እየገጠማቸው ነው።
oromo: Mootummaan Israa'el ganda Masaafar Yattaa keessatti manneen jireenyaa, bu'uuraalee misooma bishaanii fi meeshaalee anniisaa aduu diiguun miidhaa guddaa geessisaa jira. Ijaarsawwan kun manneen barnootaas kan ilaallatu yoo ta'u, buldoozaroonni waraanaa kutaa barnootaa diiguun barattoota miidheera. Jiraattonni naannichaa imaanaa ijaarsa Israa'el irraa kan ka'e, mirga barumsaa fi mana jireenyaa isaanii kabajchiisuuf rakkoo cimaa keessa jiru.

title: Saudi Arabia says East-West pipeline hit by drones launched from Iraq
english: Saudi Arabia’s East-West oil pipeline was recently damaged by drone strikes originating from Iraq, forcing a temporary shutdown of the facility and causing some injuries. While Saudi Arabia condemned the attack, it has agreed to hold off on immediate retaliation to allow the Iraqi government time to address security lapses within its own borders. Iraq has officially denounced the aggression and responded by dismissing a senior military commander responsible for the province where the drones were launched.
amharic: የሳውዲ አረቢያ የምስራቅ-ምዕራብ የነዳጅ ማስተላለፊያ መስመር ከኢራቅ በተላኩ ድሮኖች ጥቃት ደርሶበት ጉዳት የደረሰ ሲሆን ይህም መስመሩ እንዲዘጋ አድርጓል። ሳውዲ አረቢያ ጥቃቱን በጽኑ ብትቃወምም፣ የኢራቅ መንግስት በአገሩ ውስጥ ያሉ የጸጥታ ክፍተቶችን እንዲያስተካክል ጊዜ ለመስጠት ሲባል አጸፋዊ እርምጃ ከመውሰድ ተቆጥባለች። ኢራቅ ጥቃቱን በይፋ ያወገዘች ሲሆን ድሮኖቹ ከተላኩበት ግዛት ጋር በተያያዘ የጦር አዛዡን ከስልጣን አንስታለች።
oromo: Itti hidhiin boba'aa bahaa fi dhihaa Sa'udii Arabaa xiyyara malee kan irraa fagaatanii to'ataman (drones) Iraaq keessaa dhufaniin miidhamee ture, kunis miidhaa qaamaa fi cufiinsa iddoo sanaa fideera. Sa'udiin haleellaa kana balaaleffattu illee, mootummaan Iraaq daangaa isaa keessatti tasgabbii uumuuf carraa akka argatuuf jedhee battalatti deebii waraanaa kennuurraa of qusattee jirti. Iraaq haleellaa kana kan balaaleffatte yoo ta'u, xiyyaroonni sun bakka itti bobbaafaman kan to'atu ajajaa waraanaa irraa aangoo irraa kaasuun tarkaanfii fudhatteetti.

title: Sabalenka vs Rybakina: US Open women’s singles final – start, prize, form
english: The 2026 US Open women's singles final will feature a high-stakes match between two-time defending champion Aryna Sabalenka and the incoming world number one, Elena Rybakina. The game is scheduled for Saturday at the Arthur Ashe Stadium in New York. Sabalenka is aiming to secure her third consecutive title, while Rybakina looks to claim her first US Open victory after overtaking Sabalenka in the world rankings.
amharic: የ2026 የዩኤስ ኦፕን የሴቶች የነጠላ ፍጻሜ ውድድር ሁለት ጊዜ የሻምፒዮንነት ክብሩን የያዘችው አሪና ሳባሌንካ እና ቀጣይ የዓለም ቁጥር አንድ ተጫዋች ኤሌና ሪባኪናን ያገናኛል። ጨዋታው ቅዳሜ በኒውዮርክ አርተር አሼ ስታዲየም የሚካሄድ ሲሆን፣ ሳባሌንካ ለሶስተኛ ተከታታይ ጊዜ ዋንጫውን ለማንሳት ትጥራለች። በበኩሏ ሪባኪና በዓለም ደረጃ አሰጣጥ ሳባሌንካን በመቅደም፣ የመጀመሪያውን የዩኤስ ኦፕን ድል ለመቀዳጀት ትጫወታለች።
oromo: Fiinaliin dorgommii ispoortii tenisii dubartoota US Open bara 2026, qophii cimaa kan ta'e gidduu shaampiyoonaa yeroo lamaa Aryna Sabalenka fi taphataa addunyaa sadarkaa tokkoffaa haaraa ta'uuf jirtu Elena Rybakina gidduutti kan taasifamu ta'a. Taphichi guyyaa Dilbataatti dirree Arthur Ashe Stadium kan qabame yoo ta'u, Sabalenka yeroo sadaffaaf walitti aansitee injifachuuf qophoofteetti. Gamtaan immoo Rybakina, sadarkaa addunyaarratti Sabalenka dabarsitee erga argattee booda, injifannoo US Open isa jalqabaa galmeessuuf carraaqxiin gooti.

title: Razaullah’s six-hitting debut caps Pakistan’s fightback against England
english: In the third Test match against England, debutant Razaullah led a spirited Pakistan comeback with an explosive 81 runs off 63 balls, including nine sixes. Supported by Mohammad Abbas, he helped lift Pakistan to a 130-run lead by the end of the third day. Although England dominated the series, this late surge ensures the match continues into Saturday.
amharic: በእንግሊዝ እና በፓኪስታን መካከል በሚካሄደው ሦስተኛው የቴስት ጨዋታ፣ አዲስ ተጫዋች የሆነው ረዛኡላህ ዘጠኝ ስድስት ነጥቦችን በማስመዝገብ ፓኪስታን ውጤቷን እንድታሻሽል ረድቷል። ከመሐመድ አባስ ጋር በመጣመር በሦስተኛው ቀን መጨረሻ ፓኪስታን የ130 ነጥብ መሪነትን እንድትይዝ አስችለዋል። እንግሊዝ ተከታታይ ጨዋታዎችን በበላይነት ብትመራም፣ የፓኪስታን ጠንካራ ብቃት ጨዋታው እስከ ቅዳሜ እንዲቀጥል አድርጎታል።
oromo: Tapha tiri-tiri sadaffaa Ingilizii fi Paakistaan gidduutti godhameen, taphataan haaraan Raza'ullaah jedhamu rukuttaa 'six' sagalii fi bu'aa 81 galchuun Paakistaan injifannoo argachuuf akka carraaqxu taasiseera. Inni Mohaammad Abbaas wajjin ta'uun guyyaa sadaffaatti Paakistaan qabxii 130 akka dursitu gargaareera. Ingilizni taphicharratti ol aantummaa qabaatus, qabsoon Paakistaan kun taphichi hanga guyyaa Sanbataatti akka itti fufu godheera.

title: Can BRICS help reshape global order by strengthening emerging economies?
english: Leaders from 11 BRICS nations are gathering in New Delhi to discuss strengthening emerging economies and rebalancing the global order. The summit faces significant challenges, particularly the ongoing conflict involving Iran, which tests the bloc's internal unity given the presence of both Iran and its regional rivals. Additionally, members are addressing global trade instability caused by recent US tariff policies and energy disruptions.
amharic: የ11ቱ የብሪክስ (BRICS) አባል ሀገራት መሪዎች በማደግ ላይ ያሉ ኢኮኖሚዎችን ለማጠናከር እና ዓለም አቀፋዊ የኃይል ሚዛንን ለመቀየር በኒው ዴልሂ ተሰብስበዋል። አባል ሀገራቱ በአሁኑ ወቅት በኢራን እና በክልሉ ባሉ ተቀናቃኞቿ መካከል ያለው ውጥረት በቡድኑ አንድነት ላይ የሚፈጥረውን ፈተና ለመቋቋም እየመከሩ ነው። በተጨማሪም መሪዎቹ በአሜሪካ የንግድ ፖሊሲዎች እና በኃይል አቅርቦት መስተጓጎል ሳቢያ በተፈጠረው ዓለም አቀፍ የኢኮኖሚ ቀውስ ላይ ውይይት እያደረጉ ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni biyyoota miseensa BRICS 11 ta'an diinagdee biyyoota guddatanii jiran cimsuuf fi tartiiba addunyaa haaromsuuf Niiw Deelhiitti walga'ii gaggeessaa jiru. Walga'iin kun walitti bu'iinsa gara fuulduraa Iran fi biyyoota ollaa ishee gidduutti uumamee jiruun kan wal qabatu ta'ee, kunis tokkummaa garee kanaa qoruu danda'a. Kana malees, hoggantoonni kunneen dhiibbaa siyaasa daldala US fi rakkoo dhiyeessii anniisaa addunyaa irra gahu irratti mari'achaa jiru.

title: Hot pursuit: Man who robbed Indian bank using chilli powder arrested
english: A man was recently arrested in Nagpur, India, after he robbed a bank by throwing chilli powder at staff members to blind them. The suspect managed to steal approximately $4,200 during the attack. Fortunately, local police were able to locate the individual and recover all the stolen money within half an hour of the crime.
amharic: በህንድ ናግፑር ከተማ አንድ ግለሰብ የባንክ ሰራተኞችን በአይናቸው ላይ በርበሬ በመነስነስ በማስፈራራት ወደ 4,200 ዶላር ዘርፎ ነበር። ይሁን እንጂ ፖሊስ ወንጀለኛው ድርጊቱን በፈጸመ በ30 ደቂቃ ውስጥ እሱን መያዝ ችሏል። የተሰረቀው ገንዘብ በሙሉ በህግ አካላት ቁጥጥር ስር ውሏል።
oromo: Namichi tokko magaala Nagpuur kan Hindii keessatti argamuutti, hojjettoota baankii irratti daakuu mirsii facaasuudhaan qarshii 4,200 ta'u saamatee ture. Ta'us, poolisiin daqiiqaa 30 keessatti shakkamaa kana to'annaa jala oolchuu danda'eera. Qarshichi hundi yakka booda battalumaan deebifameera.

title: Declassified documents show UK aware of Israeli war crimes for 24 years
english: Newly released British government documents reveal that UK officials were aware of systematic human rights abuses by Israeli forces as early as 2002. Despite these internal warnings describing the military's actions as undisciplined and brutal, the British government continued to supply arms to Israel for over two decades. The files highlight a long-standing awareness of these violations, contrasting sharply with recent shifts in official British rhetoric regarding the conflict.
amharic: በቅርቡ ይፋ የተደረጉ የብሪታንያ የመንግስት ሰነዶች እንደሚያሳዩት፣ የዩኬ ዲፕሎማቶች እስራኤል በዌስት ባንክ የፈጸመቻቸውን የሰብአዊ መብት ጥሰቶች ከ2002 ዓ.ም ጀምሮ ያውቁ ነበር። የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ እርምጃዎች ጨካኝ እና ዲሲፕሊን የሌላቸው መሆናቸውን በውስጥ ዘገባዎች ቢገልጹም፣ ብሪታንያ ለሁለት አስርት ዓመታት ያህል ለሀገሪቱ የጦር መሳሪያ ማቅረቧን ቀጥላለች። ይህ መረጃ የብሪታንያ መንግስት ስለ እስራኤል ድርጊት ለረጅም ጊዜ ግንዛቤ እንደነበረው የሚያረጋግጥ ነው።
oromo: Sanado mootummaa Breetaanii dhiheenya ifa ta'an akka agarsiisanitti, qondaaltonni Breetaanii humnoonni Israa'el bara 2002 irraa jalqabee sarbama mirga namoomaa raawwachaa turuu beekuu turan. Gochi waraana Israa'el kan adaba hin qabne fi hamaa ta'uu gabaasni keessoo ibsu illee, mootummaan Breetaanii waggoota digdamii oliif meeshaa waraanaa Israa'eliif dhiheessaa tureera. Sanadoonni kun mootummaan Breetaanii gocha Israa'el irratti hubannoo gahaa qabaachuu isaa kan mirkaneessan dha.

title: Saudi Arabia says drones launched from Iraq hit East-West Pipeline, holds off on retaliation
english: Saudi Arabia reported that drone attacks originating from Iraq struck its East-West oil pipeline. Despite this aggression, the kingdom has decided to pause any retaliatory actions at the request of the Iraqi prime minister. However, Saudi officials emphasized that they maintain the right to defend their national security and infrastructure if necessary.
amharic: ሳውዲ አረቢያ ከኢራቅ በተነሱ ድሮኖች የምስራቅ-ምዕራብ የነዳጅ ቧንቧ መስመሯ ጥቃት እንደደረሰበት አስታውቃለች። ምንም እንኳን ጥቃቱ ቢደርስም፣ የኢራቅ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር ባቀረቡት ጥያቄ መሰረት ሳውዲ አረቢያ አጸፋዊ እርምጃ ከመውሰድ ተቆጥባለች። ይሁን እንጂ ሀገሪቱ የሉዓላዊነቷን እና የደህንነቷን ደህንነት ለማስጠበቅ አስፈላጊ ሆኖ ሲገኝ እርምጃ የመውሰድ መብቷ የተጠበቀ መሆኑን አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Saudii Arabiyaan sarara boba'aa bahaa-dhihaa ishee irra miidhaan kan gahe xiyyara nama hin feene (drones) Iraaq irraa ka'aniin akka ta'e ibsiteetti. Ta'us, gaaffii muummichi ministeera Iraaq dhiyeessaniin, mootummaan Saudii hanga ammaatti tarkaanfii haaloo bahuu irraa of qusateera. Kanaa wajjinis, biyyattiin nageenya fi mirga abbaa biyyummaa ishee kabachiisuuf jecha yeroo barbaachisaa ta'eetti tarkaanfii fudhachuuf mirga akka qabdu ibsiteetti.

title: Saudi Arabia says it closed vital East-West Pipeline after attack
english: Saudi Arabia has suspended operations on its critical East-West Pipeline following multiple attacks on Thursday that caused significant damage. While the perpetrators were not officially identified, the incident occurs amid heightening regional instability and Houthi military advances near the Red Sea. This closure creates further pressure on global oil markets, which were already struggling with rising prices due to regional conflict.
