Haleellicha kan raawwate eenyu akka ta'e ifa baasu baatanis, ta'ichi kan uumame waraana naannichaa fi guddina humna Huutii waliin wal-qabata. Cufamuun booyyee kanaa gatiin boba'aa addunyaa irratti akka olka'uufi dhiibbaa diinagdee cimaa akka uumu sodaatameera.

title: Turkey's foreign minister discusses attacks on Saudi Arabia with Saudi counterpart, source says
english: Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan recently held a phone conversation with his Saudi counterpart, Prince Faisal bin Farhan Al Saud. The two leaders reviewed regional stability and addressed recent security threats faced by Saudi Arabia. This discussion follows a recent defense cooperation agreement signed between Turkey, Saudi Arabia, and Pakistan.
amharic: የቱርክ የውጭ ጉዳይ ሚኒስትር ሃካን ፊዳን ከሳውዲ አቻቸው ልዑል ፋይሰል ቢን ፋርሃን አል ሳውድ ጋር በስልክ ተወያይተዋል። መሪዎቹ ስለ ቀጠናው ሁኔታ እና በሳውዲ አረቢያ ላይ ስለተፈጸሙ ጥቃቶች መክረዋል። ይህ ውይይት የተካሄደው ቱርክ ከሳውዲ አረቢያ እና ከፓኪስታን ጋር የጋራ የመከላከያ ስምምነት ከተፈራረሙ በኋላ ነው።
oromo: Ministirri Dhimmi Alaa Turkii Haakan Fidaan, ministira dhimmi alaa Saudii Amiir Faysal biin Farhaan Al Saud waliin bilbilan mari’ataniiru. Hoggantoonni kunneen haala naannichaa fi weerara dhiheenya kana Saudi Arabiyaa irratti raawwatame irratti mari’ataniiru. Mariin kunis biyyoonni kunneen, jechuunis Turkii, Saudii Arabiyaa fi Paakistaan walii-galtee ittisa biyyaa erga mallatteessanii booda kan ta’e dha.

title: Israel will not give Greece the source code for air-defence system: Report
english: Israel has decided not to share the primary source code for a $3.5 billion air-defense system it is building for Greece. While Greece will not have control over the core Israeli software, the Israeli defense ministry plans to help Athens develop a secondary, independent code that will allow Greek operators to manage their own system requirements. This situation highlights the common practice where nations retain technological control over advanced military exports to maintain a strategic advantage.
amharic: እስራኤል ለግሪክ በምትገነባው የ3.5 ቢሊዮን ዶላር የአየር መከላከያ ሥርዓት ላይ ዋናውን የኮምፒውተር ፕሮግራም ኮድ (source code) እንደማትሰጥ አስታውቃለች። ግሪክ የዋናውን ሥርዓት ሙሉ ቁጥጥር ባታገኝም፣ እስራኤል ለግሪክ የራሷን የውስጥ ኮድ እንድታዘጋጅ በመርዳት የሀገሪቱን የመከላከያ ፍላጎቶች በራሷ እንድትፈታ እንደምትደግፍ ገልጻለች። ይህ አካሄድ ሀገራት ለሌሎች ሲሸጡ ከፍተኛ የቴክኖሎጂ ቁጥጥርን የመጠበቅ ልምዳቸውን የሚያሳይ ነው።
oromo: Israa'el sirna ittisa qilleensaa gurguddaa kan biyyattii Giriikiif dollarri biliyoona 3.5 itti bahee ijaaramaa jiru irratti, koodii sirnicha to'atu (source code) Giriikiif akka hin kennine beeksisiteerti. Giriik to'annoo koodii ijoo Israa'el haala hin qabaanneef malee, mootummaan Israa'el Giriikiin koodii adda ta'e kan mataa ishee akka qabaattuuf gargaarsa akka gootu beekameera. Adeemsi kun biyyoonni meeshaalee waraanaa ammayyaa ergan yeroo hunda koodii fi tooftaa teeknoolojii isaanii of harkatti qabachuu akka barbaadan kan agarsiisuudha.

title: No military solution to conflict in Yemen, Eritrean foreign minister says
english: Eritrea's Foreign Minister Osman Saleh stated that the conflict in Yemen cannot be resolved through military force, emphasizing that external powers will not succeed in controlling the country. He noted that Yemen lacks a unified government, which complicates regional security efforts and the management of maritime routes in the Red Sea. Ultimately, he argued that Yemen must be allowed to achieve peace through non-military means.

oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Eertiraa Osman Saaleh, rakkoon Yemen waraanaan furamuu akka hin dandeenyeefi humnoonni alaa ummata Yemen injifachuu akka hin dandeenye dubbataniiru. Yemen keessatti mootummaan tokko ta'e waan hin jirreef, nageenya naannichaa fi nageenya daandii galaana Diimaa eeguun ulfaataa ta'uu ibsaniiru. Kanaafuu, Yemen nagaa argachuuf karaa waraana hin taaneen furmaata barbaaduu akka qabdu dhaamaniiru.

title: Houthis claim major advance in Yemen and tighten grip on Red Sea shipping lane
english: The Houthi rebels in Yemen have significantly expanded their territorial control by seizing the strategic Perim Island and the port of Mokha. This military advance strengthens their influence over the vital Bab al-Mandab Strait, a crucial global shipping route. While the Houthis claim that international maritime travel remains safe, they continue to threaten Saudi Arabian vessels, prompting Saudi leadership to seek US military intervention.

title: Norway's Princess Astrid dies two days after attending brother King Harald's funeral
english: Princess Astrid of Norway has passed away at the age of 94, just two days after attending the funeral of her brother, the late King Harald V. As the last surviving child of King Olav V, she previously served as the nation's first lady for over a decade. The Norwegian government has announced that she will receive a state funeral, with flags across the country lowered to honor her life and service.

oromo: 公主阿斯特丽德 (Princess Astrid) 逝世，享年94岁。在此前两天，她刚刚参加了其兄长哈拉尔五世国王的葬礼。作为奥拉夫五世国王最后一位在世的子女，她曾担任挪威第一夫人长达十多年。挪威政府宣布将为其举行国葬，全国降半旗以示哀悼。

title: US declares end of largest recorded cyclosporiasis outbreak
english: US health authorities have officially ended the investigation into the country’s biggest cyclosporiasis outbreak, which was caused by contaminated iceberg lettuce from Mexico. The incident resulted in nearly 13,000 illnesses, 570 hospitalizations, and two tragic deaths across 21 states. Officials confirmed that the tainted products have been successfully removed from store shelves and restaurant supply chains.
amharic: የአሜሪካ የጤና ባለስልጣናት በሜክሲኮ በተመረተ የተበከለ የአይስበርግ ሰላጣ ሳቢያ ተከስቶ የነበረው ትልቁ የሳይክሎስፖሪያሲስ ወረርሽኝ ማብቃቱን ይፋ አድርገዋል። ይህ ወረርሽኝ በ21 ግዛቶች ውስጥ ወደ 13,000 የሚጠጉ ሰዎችን በማሳመም፣ 570 ሰዎችን ለሆስፒታል በመዳረግ እና የሁለት ሰዎችን ህይወት ቀጥፏል። ችግር ያለባቸው ምርቶች ከገበያ እና ከምግብ ቤቶች ሙሉ ለሙሉ መወገዳቸውን ባለስልጣናቱ አረጋግጠዋል።

Dhibeen kun namoota 13,000 gahuu, namoota 570 hospitaala galchuufi lubbuu namoota lamaa kan galaafate yoo tahu, namoonni miidhaan irra gahe kunneenis aanaalee 21 keessa kan jiraatanidha. Qorannoo booda, salaanni faayale kun gabaa fi bakkeewwan nyaataa irraa guutummaatti akka kaafame mirkanaa'eera.

title: UK lawmakers vote against bill to legalise assisted dying
english: The UK House of Commons has rejected a proposed bill that would have allowed terminally ill adults in England and Wales to seek assisted dying. The legislation was defeated by a narrow margin of 286 to 270 votes after lawmakers were given a free vote based on their personal conscience. While advocates expressed significant disappointment, the failure of this measure means the issue cannot be revisited during the current parliamentary session.

oromo: Mana maree bakka bu'oota uummataa UK keessatti, namoonni dhukkuba cimaan qabaman fedhii isaaniitiin lubbuu isaanii akka dabarsan kan hayyamu seera dhiyaatee ture sagalee caalmaan kufuu isaatu beekame. Miseensonni mana maree kun dhimma kana irratti ilaalcha mataa isaanii irratti hundaa'uun sagalee kan kennan yoo ta'u, seerni kun sagalee 286n mormamee 270n deggerame. Akkaataa kanaan seerni kun ragga'uu hin dandeenye yoo ta'u, murteen kun guddina guddaa kan ta'eef deggertoonni seera kanaa abdii kutachuu isaanii ibsaniiru.

title: Rising petrol costs drive sharp inflation increase in US in August
english: Consumer prices in the United States rose significantly in August, largely due to a sharp increase in petrol costs linked to rising global oil prices and geopolitical tensions. This monthly price hike was the largest seen in four months, pushing annual inflation to 3.4 percent. As fuel and other goods become more expensive, there is growing anticipation that the Federal Reserve will raise interest rates soon.
amharic: በአሜሪካ የነዳጅ ዋጋ መጨመር እና በዓለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ ገበያ ላይ ያለው የጂኦፖለቲካዊ ውጥረት የነዳጅ ዋጋ እንዲንር በማድረጉ የኦገስት ወር የዋጋ ግሽበት እንዲጨምር አድርጓል። ይህ የዋጋ ጭማሪ በአራት ወራት ውስጥ ከፍተኛው ሲሆን ዓመታዊ የዋጋ ግሽበቱንም 3.4 በመቶ ላይ አድርሶታል። የነዳጅና የሌሎች ምርቶች ዋጋ መናር የፌዴራል ሪዘርቭ የወለድ ምጣኔን ይጨምራል የሚል ግምት እንዲፈጠር አድርጓል።
oromo: Amerikaa keessatti gatiin boba'aa dabaluu fi rakkoon siyaasaa biyyoota alaa gatii boba'aa addunyaa ol kaasuu isaatiin, ji'a Hagayyaa keessa gatiin meeshaalee gurguddoo dabalee jira. Daballiin gatii kun ji'oota afur keessatti isa olaanaa yoo ta'u, gatiin meeshaalee waggaa keessatti gara dhibbeentaa 3.4tti ol guddateera. Daballiin gatii boba'aa fi meeshaalee biroo kun, Baankii Federaalaa (Federal Reserve) dhala baankii akka dabaluuf yaada jiruuf sababa ta'eera.

title: ‘Handcuffed and blindfolded’: Is the US targeting Ecuadorian fishermen?
english: Ecuadorian fishermen are accusing the United States military of attacking and destroying their boats during aggressive anti-drug operations in the Pacific Ocean. Many crew members report being detained, handcuffed, and blindfolded by US soldiers despite claiming they were only engaged in legal fishing activities. While the US military denies these specific allegations, reports suggest that maritime strikes have increased significantly under President Trump's administration.
amharic: የኢኳዶር አሳ አጥማጆች በአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል ኃይሎች በፓስፊክ ውቅያኖስ ላይ በሚያደርጉት ጥብቅ የዕፅ አዘዋዋሪዎች ቁጥጥር ወቅት ጀልባዎቻቸው እየጠቁ እንደሆነ ይናገራሉ። አሳ አጥማጆቹ ህጋዊ የዓሣ ማጥመድ ሥራ ላይ ሳሉ በአሜሪካ ወታደሮች ታስረው እንደተደበደቡና ታፍነው እንደተወሰዱ ይገልጻሉ። የአሜሪካ ወታደራዊ አመራር ክሱን ቢክድም፣ በፕሬዝዳንት ትራምፕ አስተዳደር ስር በአሳ አጥማጅ ጀልባዎች ላይ የሚወሰዱ ጥቃቶች በከፍተኛ ሁኔታ መጨመራቸው ተጠቁሟል።
oromo: Qulqulleeyyonni qurxummii kan Ekuwadoor humnoonni waraana Ameerikaa hojii farra gurgurtaa qoricha sammua namaa cabsuu jedhaniin ganda isaanii irratti miidhaa geessisaa jiru jechuun himatu. Qulqulleeyyonni kunneen hojii qurxummii seera qabeessa ta'e irratti osoo jiranii, waraanni Ameerikaa akka isaan hidhee fi ija isaanirraa duucha jedhu. Waraanni Ameerikaa himannaa kana kan haalu ta'us, bulchiinsa Preezdaant Traamp jalatti weerarri markaba qulqulleeyyii qurxummii irratti gaggeeffamu dabalaa dhufeera.

title: Morocco PM takes aim at federation chief over 2030 World Cup final boast
english: Moroccan Prime Minister Aziz Akhannouch has criticized the head of the national football federation, Fouzi Lekjaa, for prematurely claiming that Morocco will host the 2030 World Cup final. The Prime Minister emphasized that such a major decision requires coordination with co-hosts Spain and Portugal and has not yet been confirmed by FIFA. Akhannouch warned against using the tournament as a political tool for election campaigns, urging officials to show diplomatic respect to their partners.
amharic: የሞሮኮ ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትር አዚዝ አክሃኑሽ የሀገሪቱ የእግር ኳስ ፌዴሬሽን ፕሬዝዳንት ፉዚ ሌክጃ የ2030 የዓለም ዋንጫ ፍጻሜ በሞሮኮ እንደሚካሄድ አስቀድመው በመናገራቸው ተችተዋል። ጠቅላይ ሚኒስትሩ እንደዚህ አይነት ትልቅ ውሳኔ ከጋራ አዘጋጆች ስፔን እና ፖርቱጋል ጋር መመካከርን የሚጠይቅ መሆኑን እና ፊፋም እስካሁን ይፋዊ ውሳኔ እንዳልሰጠ ገልጸዋል። የውድድሩን አስተናጋጅነት ለምርጫ ቅስቀሳ መጠቀሚያ ማድረግ እንደማይገባ በማስጠንቀቅ፣ ለባልደረባ ሀገራት ተገቢውን ክብር መስጠት እንደሚያስፈልግ አሳስበዋል።
oromo: Mummichi ministeeraa biyya Marookoo Aziiz Akhaanush, hoogganaan federeeshinii kubbaa miilaa biyyattii Fuuzii Lekjaa, xumura waancaa addunyaa kan bara 2030 Marookoo keessatti akka gaggeeffamu dursanii dubbachuusaanii balaaleffataniiru. Mummichi ministeerichaa akka jedhanitti, murteen gurguddaan akkasii biyyoota waliin qopheessitoota ta'an Ispeenfi Poorchugaal wajjin mari'atamuu akka qabuufi FIFA'n hanga ammaa murtoo hin kennine ibsaniiru. Dhimma waancaa addunyaa kana duula filannoof akka meeshaatti fayyadamuu akka hin qabne akeekkachiisanii, biyyoota waliin hojjetanuf kabaja kennuun akka barbaachisu dhaamaniiru.

title: Israel says it has destroyed major underground Hezbollah base
english: The Israeli military has demolished a significant underground Hezbollah complex in southern Lebanon by detonating over 1,000 tonnes of explosives. This massive operation destroyed two tunnels spanning two kilometers, triggering tremors that were felt in surrounding cities and caused panic among local residents. The site served as a strategic hub for Hezbollah, housing weapons and command centers that the IDF claims were established with Iranian support over the past twenty years.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በደቡብ ሊባኖስ የሚገኝ የሂዝቦላህን ዋነኛ የመሬት ውስጥ መሠረተ ልማት ከ1,000 ቶን በላይ ፈንጂዎችን በመጠቀም አውድሟል። ይህ ግዙፍ ጥቃት ከሁለት ኪሎ ሜትር በላይ የሚረዝሙ ዋሻዎችን ያወደመ ሲሆን፣ በግዛቱ ላይ 4.1 የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ መጠን ያለው ንዝረት በመፍጠሩ በአካባቢው ነዋሪዎች ዘንድ ከፍተኛ ድንጋጤን ፈጥሯል። እስራኤል ይህ ስፍራ ላለፉት ሁለት አስርት ዓመታት በኢራን ድጋፍ የተገነባ የጦር መሳሪያ ማከማቻና የትዕዛዝ ማዕከል እንደነበር አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el buufata gurguddaa garee Hizbullaah kan lafa jalaatti argamu, mi'a polopileeshiniifi dhuka'aa toonii 1,000 ol ta'uun barbadeesseera. Haleellaa kanaanis daandii lafa jalaa kilomeetira lama dheeratu kan barbadeesse yoo ta'u, kunis sochiin lafaa (earthquake) hanga 4.1 ga'u akka uumamu taasiseera. Israa'el buufanni kun waggoota 20 darban keessa deeggarsa Iraaniin kan ijaarame ta'uu ibsuun, iddoo meeshaalee waraanaa fi lafa itti ajajaa turan akka ta'e himteetti.

title: Ebola case detected in seventh DR Congo province
english: A new Ebola case has been confirmed in the South-Ubangi province of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, marking the seventh province affected by the current outbreak. The patient, who tested positive for the Bundibugyo strain, reportedly contracted the virus while traveling through other regions before moving to South-Ubangi. This outbreak is currently the largest and deadliest in the nation's history, with health officials warning that the disease remains difficult to contain.
amharic: በኮንጎ ዲሞክራቲክ ሪፐብሊክ የኢቦላ ወረርሽኝ ወደ ሰባተኛው ግዛት ማለትም ወደ ደቡብ ኡባንጊ መድረሱ ተረጋግጧል። በቫይረሱ የተያዘው ሰው በሌሎች አካባቢዎች ከተዘዋወረ በኋላ በምርመራ የቡንዲቡግዮ ዝርያ እንዳለበት ታውቋል። ይህ ወረርሽኝ በሀገሪቱ ታሪክ እጅግ አደገኛ እና አብዛኞቹን ህይወት የቀጠፈ ሆኖ ሳለ፣ የጤና ባለሙያዎች በሽታውን ለመቆጣጠር ፈታኝ እንደሆነ አስጠንቅቀዋል።
oromo: Vaayrasii Ibolaa namatti argamuun isaa kan mirkanaa'e naannoo Kibba-Ubaangii kan mootummaa Dimokraatawaa Koongoo keessatti yoo ta'u, kunis naannoo torbaffa dhibee kanaan miidhame dha. Namichi vaayrasii kana qabu kun adeemsa isaa keessatti naannolee biroo keessa darbuun isaa kan ibsame yoo ta'u, qorannoon isaa akaakuu 'Bundibugyo' jedhamuun qabamuu isaa mirkaneesseera. Dhibeen kun seenaa biyyattii keessatti baay'ina du'aatiin kan isa duraa caaluu fi to'achuuf rakkisaa ta'uu ogeeyyonni fayyaa ibsaniiru.

title: Hull City’s Sorba Thomas unharmed as car overturned in crash
english: Hull City winger Sorba Thomas was involved in a car accident near the team's training facility in Cottingham. Although his vehicle flipped over and left the scene with significant damage, the club confirmed that the player was not injured. Thomas, who recently joined the team, is safe and unharmed following the incident.
amharic: የሃል ሲቲው አጥቂ ሶርባ ቶማስ በኮቲንግሃም በሚገኘው የክለቡ ልምምድ ማዕከል አቅራቢያ በደረሰ የመኪና አደጋ ውስጥ ገብቶ ነበር። ምንም እንኳን መኪናው ተገልብጦ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ቢደርስበትም፣ ተጫዋቹ ምንም አይነት ጉዳት እንዳልደረሰበት ክለቡ አረጋግጧል። በቅርቡ ወደ ቡድኑ የተቀላቀለው ቶማስ ከአደጋው በሰላም መትረፉን ተገልጿል።
oromo: Taphataan garee Hull City Sorba Thomas bakka leenjii garee isaanii kan Cottingham jedhamu biratti balaa konkolaataa mudateera. Konkolaataan isaa kan garagalee miidhaan guddaan irra ga'e ta'us, gareen isaa taphataan kun miidhaa tokko illee akka hin qaqqabne mirkaneesseera. Sorba Thomas yeroo dhihoo as garee kanaatti kan makame yoo ta'u, balaa kana booda fayyaa ta'uun isaa ibsameera.

title: ‘Majority do not welcome him’: Trump heads to Ireland amid fury over Gaza
english: Donald Trump is facing significant public backlash as he arrives in Ireland for a diplomatic visit. A large majority of the Irish population opposes his trip due to his administration's support for Israel’s actions in Gaza. Activists and students are organizing large-scale protests, while government officials remain cautious about the visit amidst these tensions.
amharic: ዶናልድ ትራምፕ ወደ አየርላንድ ሲያመሩ ከፍተኛ የህዝብ ተቃውሞ ገጥሟቸዋል። አብዛኛው የአየርላንድ ህዝብ ትራምፕ በጋዛ ጉዳይ ለእስራኤል ያላቸውን ድጋፍ በመቃወም ጉብኝታቸውን አይቀበልም። ተማሪዎች እና አክቲቪስቶች ትልቅ ሰልፍ እያዘጋጁ ሲሆን፣ የአየርላንድ ባለስልጣናትም በዚህ ውጥረት ውስጥ ጉብኝቱን ለመከታተል ተገድደዋል።
oromo: Donald Trump gara biyya Ayirlaandi yemmuu deemu mormii guddaa uummataa isa mudachaa jira. Uummata Ayirlaandi keessaa kan baay'een isaanii, tarkaanfii mootummaan Israa'el Gaza keessatti fudhatuuf deeggarsa inni godhu mormuun, daawwannaa isaa kana hin simatan. Barattoonni fi aktiivistoonni mormii guddaa qopheessaa kan jiran yoo ta'u, hoogganoonni biyyattis yaaddoo daawwannaa kanaa irratti argamu.

title: Why Pakistan is talking to Iran as the Houthi-Saudi fight escalates
english: Pakistan is actively engaging in diplomatic talks with Iran following a sharp escalation in the conflict between Saudi Arabia and Houthi forces. With Houthi militants seizing key coastal areas in Yemen, global oil prices have spiked due to fears over blocked trade routes. While Pakistan maintains a mutual defense pact with Saudi Arabia, it is currently prioritizing diplomatic outreach to Iran to manage the regional instability.
amharic: በሳውዲ አረቢያ እና በሁቲ ታጣቂዎች መካከል ያለው ግጭት እየተባባሰ በመምጣቱ ፓኪስታን ከኢራን ጋር የዲፕሎማሲ ንግግሮችን እያደረገች ነው። የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች በየመን የባህር ጠረፍ አካባቢዎችን በመቆጣጠራቸው የነዳጅ ማጓጓዣ መስመሮች ይዘጋሉ የሚል ስጋት በመፈጠሩ የነዳጅ ዋጋ ጨምሯል። ፓኪስታን ከሳውዲ አረቢያ ጋር የመከላከያ ስምምነት ቢኖራትም፣ አሁን ባለው ሁኔታ ቀጠናዊ አለመረጋጋትን ለመቀነስ ከኢራን ጋር በዲፕሎማሲያዊ መንገድ ለመስራት ትኩረት ሰጥታለች።
oromo: Waraanni gidduu Saudii Arabiyaa fi garee Huutii gidduutti taasifamu daran hammaachaa waan dhufeef, Paakistaan biyya Iraan waliin marii dippilomaasii gochaa jirti. Gareen Huutii qarqara galaana Yaman to'annoo isaa jala galchuun isaa, daandiiwwan daldala boba'aa ni cufamu soda jedhuun gatiin boba'aa addunyaa irratti akka ol ka'u taasiseera. Paakistaan waliigaltee ittisaa Saudii Arabiyaa waliin qabaattus, yeroo ammaa kana tasgabbii naannichaa eeguuf jecha marii dippilomaasii Iraan waliin taasiisuuf dursaa jirti.

title: The vanishing pharmacy of the Sundarbans
english: In the Sundarbans mangrove forest of Bangladesh, rising sea levels and salt intrusion are causing traditional medicinal plants to disappear. Local healers known as kabiraj are struggling to find the natural ingredients they have relied on for generations to treat community illnesses. As the environment degrades due to climate change, this unique, nature-based healthcare system is at risk of being lost forever.
amharic: በባንግላዴሽ በሚገኘው የሰንዳርባንስ ማንግሩቭ ደን ውስጥ እየጨመረ የመጣው የባህር ከፍታ እና የጨው መጠን ባህላዊ የመድኃኒት ተክሎች እንዲጠፉ እያደረገ ነው። ካቢራጅ በመባል የሚታወቁት የሀገር በቀል ፈዋሾች ለትውልድ ሲጠቀሙባቸው የነበሩትን የተፈጥሮ መድኃኒቶች ማግኘት እየተቸገሩ ነው። የአየር ንብረት ለውጥ አካባቢውን እየጎዳ በመምጣቱ፣ ይህ በደን ላይ የተመሠረተ የጤና አጠባበቅ ሥርዓት ሙሉ በሙሉ የመጥፋት አደጋ ተጋርጦበታል።
oromo: Bosona maangroovii Sundarbans kan Baangilaadeshi keessatti sadarkaan galaanaafi soogidda dabalaa dhufuun isaa biqiloota qorichaa aadaa mancaasaa jira. Ogeeyyonni fayyaa aadaa kan kabiraaj jedhaman, qoricha dhalootarraa dhalootatti tajaajilaa ture argachuuf rakkachaa jiru. Jijjiiramni qilleensaa naannichaa miidhaa waan jiruuf, sirni fayyaa uumama irratti hundaa'e kun guutummaatti baduuf qarqara jira.

title: Anthropic blocks possible attempt to use AI to make biological weapons
english: The AI company Anthropic recently prevented individuals from using its technology to assist in the creation of dangerous biological weapons. Their new report details various malicious activities, including cyber espionage, propaganda campaigns, and online fraud, that they have successfully blocked. While industry leaders and politicians debate the future of AI safety, companies are increasing their efforts to identify and stop the misuse of their models.
amharic: አንትሮፒክ የተባለው የሰው ሰራሽ አስተውሎት (AI) ኩባንያ ግለሰቦች ቴክኖሎጂውን በመጠቀም አደገኛ የባዮሎጂካል መሳሪያዎችን ለማምረት ያደረጉትን ሙከራ ማክሸፉን አስታውቋል። ኩባንያው ባወጣው አዲስ ሪፖርት መሰረት፣ የሳይበር ጥቃቶችን፣ የፕሮፓጋንዳ ስራዎችን እና የማጭበርበር ተግባራትን ጨምሮ የተለያዩ የቴክኖሎጂ አላግባብ አጠቃቀሞችን መቆጣጠሩን ገልጿል። በዓለማችን የAI ቴክኖሎጂ ደህንነት ላይ ከፍተኛ ክርክር እየተደረገ ባለበት በዚህ ወቅት፣ የቴክኖሎጂ ድርጅቶች የራሳቸውን ሞዴሎች አላግባብ መጠቀምን ለመከላከል ጥረታቸውን አጠናክረዋል።
oromo: Dhaabbanni teeknooloojii Anthropic jedhamu, namoonni meeshaalee waraanaa baayoloojii balaa geessisuu danda'an hojjechuuf teeknooloojii isaa fayyadamuuf yaalii taasisan akka fashaleesse beeksiseera. Gabaasni haaraa isaanii, qindoomina cyber, duula propagandaa fi gowwoomsaawwan garaagaraa teeknooloojii isaanii fayyadamuun raawwatamaa turan akka dhaabsisaniif ibseera. Yeroo ammaa mootummoonniifi abbootiin qabeenyaa teeknooloojii AI irratti waldhabdee guddaa keessa jirutti, dhaabbileen teeknooloojii gochaalee hamoo ittisuuf carraaqqii cimaa taasisaa jiru.

title: Hong Kong's Tiananmen activists sentenced to up to seven years in prison
english: Three Hong Kong activists have received prison sentences ranging from five to over seven years for organizing annual vigils to remember the 1989 Tiananmen Square crackdown. The court convicted them of inciting subversion against the state under the city's strict national security law. These commemorations were once common in Hong Kong but were banned by authorities following the implementation of the new legislation.
amharic: ሶስት የሆንግ ኮንግ አክቲቪስቶች እ.ኤ.አ በ1989 በቲያንመን አደባባይ የተፈፀመውን ጭፍጨፋ ለማስታወስ አመታዊ ሰልፎችን በማደራጀታቸው ከአምስት እስከ ሰባት ዓመት የሚደርስ እስራት ተፈርዶባቸዋል። ፍርድ ቤቱ በከተማዋ ጥብቅ በሆነው የሀገር ውስጥ ደህንነት ህግ መሰረት መንግስትን ለመገልበጥ በማነሳሳት ወንጀል ጥፋተኛ ብሏቸዋል። እነዚህ መታሰቢያዎች ቀደም ሲል በሆንግ ኮንግ ይካሄዱ የነበሩ ቢሆንም፣ አዲሱ ህግ ከወጣ በኋላ በመንግስት ታግደዋል።
oromo: Hoggantoonni mirga namoomaa Hong Kong sadii, yaadannoo ajjeechaa bara 1989 isquare Tiananmen irratti raawwatame gaggeessaa waan turaniif hidhaa waggaa shan hanga torbaatti itti murameera. Manni murtichaa seera nageenya biyyoolessaa biyyattii cabsuun mootummaan akka gadi bu'u kakaasaniiru jechuun irratti murteesse. Yaadannoon kun dur Hong Kong keessatti kan gaggeeffamaa ture ta'us, seera haaraa bahe kanaan booda mootummaan dhoorkameera.

title: Five dead and dozens injured in coach crash in Swiss Alps
english: A tourist bus carrying Dutch nationals crashed and overturned in the Swiss Alps, resulting in five deaths. Dozens of passengers sustained various injuries and were transported to local hospitals by emergency crews and helicopters. Authorities have launched an investigation to determine the exact cause of the accident, which occurred near the town of Zernez.
amharic: በስዊዘርላንድ አልፕስ ተራሮች የቱሪስት አውቶቡስ ገልባጭ አደጋ በመድረሱ አምስት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። በጉዞው ላይ የነበሩ ደርዘን የሚቆጠሩ የኔዘርላንድ ዜጎች ለተለያዩ ጉዳቶች በመዳረጋቸው በአምቡላንስ እና በሄሊኮፕተር ወደ ሆስፒታል ተወስደዋል። ባለሥልጣናት አደጋው በአካባቢው የደረሰበትን ትክክለኛ ምክንያት ለማወቅ ምርመራ መጀመራቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Alps Siwiizerlaanditti konkolaataan tajaajila tuuristii fe'ee deemu tokko garagaluun namoota shan ajjeeseera. Namoonni hedduun miidhaan irra ga'e kunis yeroo ammaa hospitaala geeffamanii yaalamaa jiru. Poolisiin naannichaa balaa kana ilaalchisee qorannoo eegaleera.

title: Buddhist monk arrested in suspected $3m embezzlement scandal
english: A prominent Thai Buddhist monk has been arrested for allegedly embezzling approximately $3 million in temple donations over a two-year period. Police discovered that money intended for monastery renovations and sacred amulets was diverted into private accounts, while a subsequent raid uncovered large amounts of gold and cash. The monk was defrocked after authorities found evidence of him breaking his vow of celibacy with a female accomplice, who was also taken into custody.
amharic: በታይላንድ ታዋቂ የሆነ አንድ የቡድሂስት መነኩሴ በሁለት ዓመት ጊዜ ውስጥ 3 ሚሊዮን ዶላር የሚገመት የቤተ መቅደስ መዋጮ በመስረቅ ወንጀል ተጠርጥረው ተይዘዋል። ፖሊስ ለቤተ መቅደሱ እድሳት እና ለተቀደሱ የጸሎት ዕቃዎች የተሰበሰበው ገንዘብ ወደ ግል መለያቸው እንደገባ እና በቤታቸውም ከፍተኛ መጠን ያለው ወርቅና ጥሬ ገንዘብ ማግኘቱን አስታውቋል። መነኩሴው ከሴት ተባባሪ ጋር ወሲብ ሲፈጽሙ የሚያሳይ ምስል መገኘቱን ተከትሎ ከሃይማኖታዊ ስልጣናቸው የተነሱ ሲሆን፣ ተባባሪዋም በቁጥጥር ስር ውላለች።
oromo: Mankuseen amantii Buddistii biyya Taayilaand keessatti bekamu tokko, waggoota lama keessatti qarshii miliyoona 3 ol ta'u kan kennaa mana amantichaa hattee argamee to'annoo jala ooleera. Poolisiin akka ibsetti, maallaqni mana amanticha suphuufi meeshaalee qulqulluu gurguruudhaan argame gara akkaawuntii dhuunfaa madaqfamee, maallaqniifi warqeen baay'eenis mana isaa keessatti argameera. Mankuseen kun kakuu isaa cabsee dubartii tokko waliin yeroo walqunnamtii saalaa raawwatu waan argameef, sadarkaa amantii isaa irraa ari'amee harki qabameera.

title: Princess Diana's 'revenge dress' goes up for auction
english: Princess Diana's famous 'revenge dress,' a custom black silk evening gown she wore in 1994, is set to be sold at a Sotheby's auction this December. The dress became iconic after she wore it to a public event shortly after Prince Charles admitted to adultery, effectively helping her regain control over her public image. Auction experts estimate the garment could reach a price of up to £220,000.
amharic: የልዕልት ዳያና ታዋቂው 'የበቀል ቀሚስ' በመባል የሚታወቀው ጥቁር የሐር ልብስ በታህሳስ ወር በሶተቢስ ጨረታ ሊሸጥ ነው። ልዕልት ዳያና ይህን ቀሚስ በ1994 የለበሱት ልዑል ቻርለስ የፍቅር ግንኙነት መፈጸማቸውን ከተናገሩ በኋላ ሲሆን፣ ይህ ድርጊታቸውም በህዝብ ዘንድ ትልቅ መነጋገሪያ ሆኖ ነበር። የጨረታ ባለሙያዎች ይህ ታሪካዊ ቀሚስ እስከ 220,000 ፓውንድ ሊሸጥ እንደሚችል ይጠብቃሉ።
oromo: Uffanni 'haaloo ba'uu' jedhamee beekamu kan illee Princess Diana bara 1994 uffatte, ji'a Muddeetti kiree ykn caalbaatii 'Sotheby's' irratti dhiyaachuuf jira. Uffanni kun kan beekame erga illee Charles hariiroo alaa qabaachuu isaa erga amanee booda, Diana ifatti mul'achuu isheetiin booda ture. Ogeeyyoonni caalbaatii kanaa uffanni seena-qabeessi kun hanga paawundii 220,000tti gurguramu danda'a jedhanii tilmaamu.

title: Republican midterm message: Democrats are the threat
english: During their midterm convention in Dallas, Republican speakers focused their campaign messaging on framing the Democratic Party as a significant danger to the United States. They used aggressive rhetoric to challenge national identity and leveraged international issues in the Middle East to gain political support. This strategy aims to characterize their opponents as extremists to influence voter sentiment ahead of the upcoming elections.
amharic: በዳላስ በተካሄደው የመሃል ዘመን ምርጫ ኮንፈረንስ ላይ የሪፐብሊካን ፓርቲ ተናጋሪዎች የዴሞክራቲክ ፓርቲን ለአሜሪካ ትልቅ ስጋት እንደሆነ ገልጸዋል። በንግግራቸውም የሀገርን ማንነት እና በመካከለኛው ምስራቅ የሚከሰቱ ክስተቶችን በመጠቀም ተቃዋሚዎቻቸውን ጽንፈኛ እንደሆኑ አድርገው ለማሳየት ሞክረዋል። ይህ አካሄድ በምርጫው ወቅት መራጮችን ወደ ጎናቸው ለማዞር ያለመ የዘመቻ ስልት ነው።
oromo: Si'a kana walga'ii filannoo giddu galeessaatti, dubbattoonni paartii Ripaabilikaanii paartii Dimokiraatawii akka sodaafi balaa guddaa biyyattii ta'etti ibsaniiru. Namoonni kunneen eenyummaa biyyoolessaa fi rakkoolee naannoo Baha Giddu galeessaa fayyadamuun mormitoota isaanii akka hammaattootatti dhiyeessuun sagalee filattootaa argachuu yaalan. Duulli kun filannoo dhufu irratti mormitoota isaanii xureessuudhaan deeggarsa argachuuf kan karoorfame dha.

title: Al Jazeera explains massive Israeli blasts on south Lebanon hill
english: The Israeli military recently carried out a massive operation in southern Lebanon, detonating over 1,100 tonnes of explosives to destroy alleged Hezbollah tunnels. These explosions were powerful enough to register as a 4.1 magnitude tremor on the Ali al-Taher ridge. Israeli officials claim the move was intended to dismantle underground infrastructure belonging to the armed group.
amharic: የእስራኤል ወታደራዊ ኃይል በደቡብ ሊባኖስ በሚገኘው የአሊ አል-ታሂር ኮረብታ ስር ይገኛሉ የተባሉ የሂዝቦላህ ዋሻዎችን ለማውደም ከ1,100 ቶን በላይ ፈንጂዎችን ተጠቅሟል። እነዚህ ፍንዳታዎች እጅግ ኃይለኛ ከመሆናቸው የተነሳ 4.1 ማግኒቱድ ያለው የመሬት መንቀጥቀጥ አስከትለዋል። እስራኤል ይህንን እርምጃ የወሰደችው የቡድኑን የመሬት ውስጥ መዋቅር ለማፈራረስ እንደሆነ አስታውቃለች።
oromo: Waraanni Israa'el kibba Libnaanotti lafa Ali al-Taher jedhamu jala turan kan jedhaman hololoo garee Hizbollaah barbadeessuuf, meeshaa waraanaa kilo giraama kuma 1,100 ol ta'u itti fayyadameera. Dhoohiinsi kun cimaa waan ta'eef, lafti sun sochii 4.1 kan qabu akka raafamu godheera. Israa'el tarkaanfii kana kan fudhatte, bu'uura misooma garee kanaa kan ta'e hololoo sana diiguuf akka ta'e ibsiteetti.

title: ‘Blew the hell out of it’: How Iran damaged US bases in Bahrain, Jordan
english: A senior US Navy official has publicly confirmed that Iranian retaliatory strikes caused severe damage to a major American naval base in Bahrain and air facilities in Jordan. The strikes, which occurred during the ongoing conflict between the US, Israel, and Iran, have severely impacted several buildings and aircraft. Consequently, the Pentagon is now conducting a formal assessment to determine whether these military installations can be repaired or if they should be abandoned.
amharic: ከፍተኛ የአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል ባለስልጣን ኢራን በወሰደችው የአጸፋ እርምጃ በባህሬን የሚገኘው የአሜሪካ የባህር ኃይል ጣቢያ እና በዮርዳኖስ የሚገኙ የአየር ማረፊያዎች ከፍተኛ ጉዳት እንደደረሰባቸው አረጋግጠዋል። በአሜሪካ፣ በእስራኤል እና በኢራን መካከል ባለው ግጭት ወቅት የተፈጸሙት እነዚህ ጥቃቶች በበርካታ ህንጻዎች እና አውሮፕላኖች ላይ ከፍተኛ ውድመት አስከትለዋል። በዚህም ሳቢያ፣ የአሜሪካ መከላከያ ሚኒስቴር የተጎዱት ወታደራዊ ጣቢያዎች መጠገን አለባቸው ወይስ መሰረዝ አለባቸው የሚለውን ለመወሰን ጥናት እያደረገ ነው።
oromo: Hoggantoonni waraana galaanaa Amerikaa akka mirkaneessanitti, tarkaanfii deebii Iran fudhatteen buufata waraanaa Amerikaa kan Bahrain keessatti argamuufi buufataalee xiyyaaraa Yordaanoos jiran irratti miidhaan cimaan ga’eera. Waraana Amerikaa, Israa’eliifi Iran gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiru kanaan buufataalee kana keessatti manneeniifi xiyyaarotni hedduun barbadaa’aniiru. Haaluma kanaan, Pentagoniin buufataaleen waraana kun suphamanii itti fufuu qabu moo dhiifamuu qabu irratti qorannoo geggeessaa jira.

title: Family members wait after deadly Philippines ferry fire
english: A passenger ferry in the Philippines caught fire, resulting in the tragic deaths of at least five people. Rescue operations are currently underway as many passengers remain unaccounted for. Distraught family members are gathered at the port in Manila, anxiously waiting for updates on the fate of their relatives.
amharic: በፊሊፒንስ አንድ የሳፋሪ መርከብ ላይ በተነሳ ድንገተኛ የእሳት አደጋ ቢያንስ አምስት ሰዎች ሕይወታቸው አልፏል። አደጋው ከደረሰ በኋላ በርካታ ተሳፋሪዎች የት እንደደረሱ ስላልታወቀ የነፍስ አድን ስራው ቀጥሏል። በከተማዋ ወደብ ላይ የተሰበሰቡ የሟቾች ቤተሰቦች ስለ ወዳጆቻቸው ሁኔታ መረጃ ለማግኘት በከፍተኛ ጭንቀት እየጠበቁ ይገኛሉ።
oromo: Filippiinis keessatti markaba namoota fe'u tokko irratti ibidda ka'een lubbuun namoota shanii ol darbeera. Namoonni hedduun erga ibidda kana booda eessa akka ga'an waan hin beekamneef, hojiin barbaachaafi fayyisuu bal'inaan itti fufee jira. Maatiin miidhame kunis ganda Manilla keessatti argamuun, waa'ee jaallatamtoota isaanii oduu gaddisiisaa ta'e dhaga'uuf sodaa guddaa keessa taa'aa jiru.

title: Houthis take control of Yemen’s Red Sea coast and key shipping route
english: Houthi forces have successfully seized control of Yemen’s entire Red Sea coastline, including critical strategic points near the Bab al-Mandeb Strait. By taking over these coastal areas and nearby islands, the group now possesses significant influence over a vital maritime passage used for global oil shipments. This development marks a major shift in the conflict, potentially threatening international trade routes that serve as alternatives to the Strait of Hormuz.
amharic: የሁቲ ታጣቂዎች የየመን ቀይ ባህር ጠረፍን ሙሉ በሙሉ መቆጣጠራቸውን ዘገባዎች አመልክተዋል። ቡድኑ በባብ አል-ማንደብ ባህር ዳርቻ እና በአቅራቢያው በሚገኙ ደሴቶች ላይ ቁጥጥር በማድረጉ ለዓለም አቀፍ የነዳጅ ማጓጓዣ ወሳኝ የሆነውን የባህር መስመር በእጃቸው አስገብተዋል። ይህ ድርጊት በክልሉ ያለውን ግጭት ከማባባሱም በላይ፣ አማራጭ የንግድ መስመሮችን አደጋ ላይ ሊጥል እንደሚችል ተሰግቷል።
oromo: Humni Houtii guutummaa qarqara galaana diimaa kan Yaman to'annoo isaanii jala galchuu gabaasni ni ibsa. Gareen kun qarqara galaana Bab al-Mandeb fi duun-galaanota naannichaa to'achuu isaaniitiin, karaa markabinni boba'aa itti darbu irratti dhiibbaa guddaa uumuu danda'aniiru. Tarkaanfin kun walitti bu'iinsa naannichaa kan hammaachiisu ta'uun, karaa daldala idil-addunyaa kanneen biroo balaaf saaxiluu danda'a.

title: Five killed and 67 injured in Russian strike on shopping centre, Ukraine says
english: A Russian drone strike on a shopping center in the Ukrainian city of Pavlohrad has resulted in five deaths and 67 injuries, including several children. This daylight attack occurred during busy hours, causing significant damage to nearby shops and vehicles. While international efforts to broker peace continue, the ongoing conflict remains intense with both sides reporting further casualties from recent drone operations.
amharic: በዩክሬን ፓቭሎህራድ ከተማ በሚገኝ የገበያ ማዕከል ላይ በተፈጸመ የሩሲያ ድሮን ጥቃት አምስት ሰዎች ሲሞቱ 67 የሚሆኑት ደግሞ ቆስለዋል። ጥቃቱ የተፈጸመው ህዝብ በሚበዛበት የቀን ሰዓት በመሆኑ በገበያ ማዕከሉ እና በአቅራቢያው ባሉ ተሽከርካሪዎች ላይ ከፍተኛ ጉዳት ደርሷል። በሁለቱ ሀገራት መካከል ሰላም ለማውረድ ጥረቶች እየተደረጉ ቢሆንም፣ የጦርነቱ መጠናከር በሁለቱም በኩል የሰዎች ህይወት መጥፋት እና ጉዳት እየቀጠለ ይገኛል።
oromo: Humni Ruusiyaa magaalaa Paavloohiraad keessatti bakka gabaa tokko irratti xiyyaara malee to’atamuun yoo rukutu, namoota shan ajjeesee 67 immoo madeesseera. Miidhaan kun kan qaqqabe guyyaa bakki gabaa namaan guutamee jirutti ta’uun, suuqotaa fi konkolaattota hedduu irratti barbadaa’ina guddaa fideera. Mormiin biyyoota lamaan gidduutti gaggeeffamaa jiru kun ittuma fufee waan jiruuf, lola kanaan miidhaan lubbuu fi qabeenyaa ittuma fufee jira.

title: Hundreds flee as fire destroys migrant shelters in Ceuta
english: A large fire broke out in the Spanish city of Ceuta, completely destroying numerous shelters housing migrants. Hundreds of individuals were forced to evacuate the area to escape the flames. Fortunately, officials confirmed that no injuries occurred, and an official investigation is now underway to determine if the fire was started intentionally.
amharic: በስፔን ሴኡታ ከተማ በተቀሰቀሰ ከባድ የእሳት አደጋ በርካታ የስደተኞች መጠለያዎች ሙሉ ለሙሉ ወድመዋል። እሳቱን በመሸሽ በመቶዎች የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች አካባቢውን ለቀው እንዲወጡ ተገደዋል። የሀገሪቱ ባለስልጣናት ምንም አይነት የሰው ህይወት መጥፋት እንዳልተመዘገበ ያረጋገጡ ሲሆን፣ እሳቱ ሆን ተብሎ የተለኮሰ መሆን አለመሆኑን ለማወቅ ምርመራ መጀመራቸውን አስታውቀዋል።
oromo: Magaalaa Se'uuta, Ispeen keessatti ibidda cimaa ka'een manni jireenyaa godaantotaa baay'een barbadaa'aniiru. Namoonni dhibbaan lakkaa'aman ibidda kana jalaa lubbuu isaanii oolchuuf iddoo sana gadhiisanii baqataniiru. Abbootiin taayitaa miidhaan qaamaa ykn lubbuu namarra hin ga'in mirkaneessanii, ibiddi kun qorannoo booda akka beekamuuf akka tasaa ykn of eeggannoo dhabuudhaan ykn immoo namoota hamootiin kan qabsiifame ta'uu isaa qorannoon eegalameera.

title: How 9/11 conspiracy theories moved into mainstream American politics
english: Twenty-five years after the September 11 attacks, conspiracy theories regarding the event have shifted from fringe internet discussions into the center of American political discourse. Driven by a general decline in public trust and the rise of social media influencers, these false narratives are now frequently used by political figures to manipulate public sentiment. This trend reflects a broader pattern of misinformation that has also influenced movements like the January 6 Capitol riot and current geopolitical debates.
amharic: የሴፕቴምበር 11 ጥቃት ከተፈጸመ ሃያ አምስት ዓመታት በኋላ፣ ስለ ክስተቱ የሚናፈሱ የሴራ ትረካዎች ከኢንተርኔት ማህበራዊ መሰረቶች ወጥተው ወደ ዋናው የአሜሪካ ፖለቲካ ውስጥ ዘልቀው ገብተዋል። በህዝብ ዘንድ ያለው የመንግስት አመኔታ መቀነስ እና የማህበራዊ ሚዲያ ተፅእኖ ፈጣሪዎች ሚና ለእነዚህ ሀሰተኛ መረጃዎች መስፋፋት ዋና ምክንያት ሆነዋል። ይህ አካሄድ ፖለቲከኞች የህዝብን ስሜት ለመቆጣጠር እና የየራሳቸውን የፖለቲካ አጀንዳ ለማራመድ የሚጠቀሙበት መሳሪያ ሆኗል።
oromo: Hujii shororkeessummaa Sadaasa 11 erga raawwatame waggaa digdamii shan booda, oduuwwan odeeffannoo sobaa ta'an kun daangaa intarneetii darbanii gara siyaasa guddicha Ameerikaa keessa seenaniiru. Hir'inni amantii ummataa fi qooda fudhannaan namoota miidiyaa hawaasaa irratti beekamtii qabanii, oduuwwan dhugaa irraa fagaatan kun akka babal'atan gargaareera. Haalli kun siyaasa keessatti jijjiirama dhufee, angawoonni siyaasaa miira ummataa to'achuuf fi fedhii isaanii guuttachuuf odeeffannoo sobaa akka meeshaatti akka fayyadaman taasiseera.

title: ‘Everything changed’: The human cost of 25 years of US wars
english: In the twenty-five years since the 9/11 attacks, United States military campaigns across various nations have resulted in the deaths of over 4.5 million people. These long-term conflicts, which began in Afghanistan and Iraq, have also caused the displacement of more than 38 million individuals. Beyond direct combat casualties, millions have perished due to secondary effects such as malnutrition, disease, and the long-term instability left behind by these wars.
amharic: ከሴፕቴምበር 11 ጥቃት በኋላ ባሉት ሃያ አምስት ዓመታት ውስጥ፣ አሜሪካ በተለያዩ ሀገራት ባካሄደችው ወታደራዊ ዘመቻ ከ4.5 ሚሊዮን በላይ ሰዎች ሕይወታቸውን አጥተዋል። በአፍጋኒስታን እና በኢራቅ የጀመሩት እነዚህ የረጅም ጊዜ ጦርነቶች ከ38 ሚሊዮን በላይ ሰዎች እንዲፈናቀሉ ምክንያት ሆነዋል። በቀጥታ ከጦርነት በተጨማሪ፣ በሚሊዮን የሚቆጠሩ ሰዎች በረሃብ፣ በተለያዩ በሽታዎች እና ከጦርነቱ በኋላ ባለው አለመረጋጋት ምክንያት ለህልፈት ተዳርገዋል።
oromo: Hojii waraanaa Ameerikaan erga haleellaa Fulbaana 11 raawwatee as biyyoota adda addaa keessatti gaggeessiteen lubbuun namoota miliyoona 4.5 olii darbeera. Waraanni Afgaanistaanii fi Iraaq keessatti jalqabe kun namoota miliyoona 38 ol buqqaaseera. Miidhaa waraanaatiin ala, namoonni miliyoonaan lakkaa'aman hanqina nyaataa, dhukkubaa fi rakkoolee nageenyaa waraanni kun duubatti hambiseef jecha lubbuun isaanii darbeera.

title: NAZA, the Israeli film revealing new layers of the Gaza genocide
english: The Israeli film NAZA has gained significant international attention and received a lengthy standing ovation at the Biennale for its critical look at the conflict in Gaza. The creators acknowledge that being Israeli granted them unique access to document the situation, highlighting a disparity where Palestinian filmmakers often encounter obstacles when trying to share their own perspectives. This documentary aims to bring new visibility to the human impact of the war through a lens rarely seen from within Israel.
amharic: NAZA የተሰኘው የእስራኤል ፊልም በጋዛ እየተካሄደ ያለውን ጦርነት በመዳሰስ በቢኤናሌ የፊልም ፌስቲቫል ላይ ከፍተኛ አድናቆትን አትርፏል። ፊልም ሰሪዎቹ የእስራኤል ዜግነት መያዛቸው ሁኔታውን ለመዘገብ እድል እንደሰጣቸው በመጥቀስ፣ የፍልስጤም ፊልም ሰሪዎች ግን ታሪካቸውን ለመንገር መሰናክሎች እንደሚገጥሟቸው አስረድተዋል። ይህ ዘጋቢ ፊልም ከእስራኤል ውስጥ ሆኖ የጦርነቱን ተፅዕኖ በተለየ መንገድ ለማሳየት ይጥራል።
oromo: Fiilmiin Israa'el NAZA jedhamu, waraana Gaazaatti gaggeeffamaa jiru irratti xiyyeeffachuun isaa fiilmiiwwan biroo keessatti fudhatama guddaa argatee jira. Qopheessitoonni fiilmichaa lammii Israa'el ta'uun isaanii haala sana ibsuuf carraa addaa akka isaanif kenne himanii, gama biraatiin garuu filmii hojjattoonni Falasxiin seenaa isaanii himuuf gufuuwwan adda addaa akka isaan mudatu ibsaniiru. Fiilmiin kun miidhaa waraana sanaa ilaalcha Israa'el keessa jiruun mul'isuuf kan kaayyeffatedha.

title: Fenerbahce coach Kartal’s resignation refused as bottle thrown in Roma tie
english: Fenerbahce coach Ismail Kartal attempted to resign after being struck by a bottle thrown by a spectator during a Champions League match against Roma. Club president Aziz Yildirim rejected the resignation, insisting that Kartal remains in his position despite the coach's distress. The club has since identified and banned the individual responsible for the incident.

oromo: Leenjisaan garee Fenerbahce Ismail Kartal, tapha Champions League Roma waliin ta'een irratti erga xalayaa bishaan qabu tokkoon rukutamee booda hojii gadhiisuuf yaalii godhee ture. Kilabichi namicha kana adda baasuun dirree isaa irraa dhorkeera.

title: Araghchi welcomes US navy secretary’s Bahrain damage remarks
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi publicly acknowledged comments made by US Navy Secretary nominee Hung Cao regarding significant damage caused to a US base in Bahrain during past attacks. Araghchi praised Cao's honesty in confirming the effectiveness of Iran's military actions against American installations. Furthermore, he used the statement to criticize US involvement in regional conflicts, suggesting that the American public should not be funding such military operations.

oromo: Ministirri Dhimma Alaa Iraan Abbaas Araagchi, mucucaannaa nama aangoo Ministira Humna Galaana Ameerikaatiif dhiyaate Hung Ka'oon buufata waraana Ameerikaa kan Baahireyn keessa jiru irratti miidhaa gahe ilaalchisee dubbatan fudhatama kennaniiru. title: Araghchi discusses regional situation with Saudi, South Korean counterparts
english: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi recently held separate phone calls with the foreign ministers of Saudi Arabia and South Korea. These discussions focused on the growing instability and rising tensions across the Middle East. Both conversations emphasized the importance of maintaining diplomatic cooperation to de-escalate regional crises and ensure maritime security.
